| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper. | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | ⬇DONATE BY CHECK⬇ Russell Fry for Congress PO Box 14641 Surfside Beach, SC 29587 | * | | | | | | |

# A Wonderful Marathon Week in D.C.
---
---
_Top L: Solomon Yue and Oregon's Judge Vance Day. Top R: Me in the DOJ library. Bottom L: Giving a press conference to an audience of four from AG Bondi's podium. Bottom R: Solomon with Peter Feaman._
---
**Misc. Meetings and the DOJ.** Last week, Solomon and I traveled to Washington D.C. with a packed schedule for both Republicans Overseas (RO) and the Oregon Conservative Caucus (OCC). Almost daily, our meetings were scheduled nonstop from breakfast through late dinner. We now have a new HQ in the Georgetown area for RO, complete with a conference room, which we used several times. That was an early success. When we first arrived, we found that D.C. was in a state of flux with everyone changing their schedules to attend either a Charlie Kirk vigil or the memorial service. The President's UK trip also created for several changes. We met with a new RO chapter leader, started lining up keynote speakers for future OCC events, and discussed the CCP threat with State Department staff in light of Secretary Rubio's increased scrutiny on visa holders advocating for violence against us on our own soil. As everyone and their dog knows, ferreting out these creeps is Solomon's area of expertise, and Sec Rubio is as serious as a heart attack about stopping this kind of infiltration.
We headed for the DOJ to say hi to Oregon's Judge Vance Day who serves as Senior Counsel to Todd Blanche, the Deputy U.S. Attorney General. That was more of a personal visit than anything because we've missed the guy! We obviously don't even know what kinds of "top secret" cases he's working on, but we know he's working nonstop and putting in some insane hours. He has a _great _office space, btw, filled with family photos and reminders of Oregon. He gave us a tour of part of the building, including the DOJ library, which I frankly could just live in for a few months and be happy. Transcripts from July 4, 1776? They're there.
We did have some actual business to discuss in the building before heading for Harmeet Dhillon's office, but she'd been called out of town and we couldn't wait, so we just texted her instead. Next time. Solomon's longtime friend, Peter Feaman, whom Harmeet has tasked with handling "educational opportunities" inside the Civil Rights division, assures us that Oregon is high on their radar when it comes to boys in girls' sports. Peter took us into the hall where AG Bondi was sworn in, then up to the 7th floor to her press room. Maintenance staff turned on all the floodlights for me so I could stand on the stage behind her podium and conduct a "press conference." Cheesy? Yes! Would I do it again? Absolutely!!! Now I know what she's seeing whenever we watch her on TV. "Lovely to work with" was the comment we heard most often to describe her.
We did hear a few times early in the week about some new "tamper-proof" Election Integrity (EI) paper ballot technology being developed at a national level, which would likely involve many agencies if it comes to fruition, so that sounded promising. Real EI efforts are happening at the federal level, by the way, not at dog and pony shows that bounce around on "tours," present false yet believable data, and accomplish nothing in the end. Do yourselves a favor and avoid listening to EI grifters; they've created a politically adjacent subindustry.
---
---
_Top L: On the steps of the Eisenhower Executive Office Building across from the side entrance to the West Wing. Top R: At the breakfast table every morning. Bottom L: One member of Congress gave us this challenge coin for our service to overseas Americans. Bottom R: 3.5 miles in 3" heels in the halls of Congress. I only made that footwear mistake once!_
---
| | **WH, Congress, and Senate.** Solomon and I took one of our RO Board Members and met with senior-level White House staff. What a great time we had inside the White House complex! Security was still touchy after the building having been on lockdown after September 10, but we were given a private tour of things like the Sec of War's conference room where Elon Musk and DOGE had set up shop. Staffers would see him wandering the halls at 2 a.m. because the guy doesn't sleep much when he's in the middle of a project. I can't get into a ton of detail, but we did talk about more EI regarding Oregon, various races, and what OCC is up to... I'm asked regularly on Facebook if the Trump Administration is aware of Oregon's issues, and the answer is 100% yes.
Then it was back to RO business. There are three congressional buildings and three senate buildings - huge buildings with white tiles, wooden doors, and connecting tunnels. We had meetings every 30 minutes for three days straight in four of them. Each morning, we started at the Republican Capitol Hill Club Grill for breakfast with our team, then off we went to hit the halls. We ran into people we knew - like former Trump Campaign staff. Solomon ran into Jim Jordan. We have a very talented lobbyist/government affairs consultant on board, and have put together legislation, which we hope to get into the next budget rec package to end the double taxation of overseas Americans. If successful, we will right an injustice while fulfilling one of President Trump's campaign promises that didn't make it into the Big Beautiful Bill. (See his video here: [https://youtu.be/vFc___HuXbc?si=uLQAJ88JNk3tPagJ)](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/86rZw_hu7RYCsha2vKgtRw~~/AAAHURA~/r2yAhA3Atuta10RpDMvJUwLUMYQAZFxumui6E1GcZ18hg0Twmu3EFv0ubxdX_wnEXfgdepHN2tRvOSNWk-UgN9mT8lS6qo08tuC_CBjH1AP7NI-rI7OaMxAQIqektwIsgrANnM3VFrtZYsCmJpT-GdA5-jqX-8tv5ppTbcBxSR1ILL2AtznDxuBu9tvfNrIb)
I'll leave out the nitty gritty of the tax structure behind our pitch, but we met with the members in committees of jurisdiction and socialized the issue to them. The universal response to us walking in with a complete solution rather than a problem was incredibly positive. We were told that Speaker Johnson had just started putting out feelers about a Big Beautiful Bill Part Deux, so if that happens, our timing may be perfect.
**The Long Flight Home.** Long story short, Solomon and I were seated with Sen. Ron Wyden for seven straight hours between delays on the tarmac and the flight itself. Sen. Jeff Merkley was somewhere behind us. I really questioned what it was that God wanted me to learn from that situation. I joked that I guessed this must be bipartisan seating, and Wyden took cautious minute to size up the situation. We all stayed cordial and treated each other like human beings, but it's safe to say I agree on NOTHING with this man. That's why it struck me so odd that he would nod and agree with _everything _I said! And with everything everyone else said! No matter what it was! I watched him at the gate and the gate staff knew him as a regular, so clearly he does return to Oregon at least sometimes. He told me he takes that flight every couple weeks, and I sensed that might be an exaggeration. His family lives in NY and his "developmentally challenged" daughter attends a private school there, he said. He also has a home in Portland, but shifted the conversation to how much time his family spends at the airport. So, I didn't discover anything people don't already know. He has been in office since 1981, and my take was that he lives to have people recognize him in public. He thought he'd helped the health care situation in Baker County mightily, btw - uh, no. "I brought in the experts!" he said. I mentioned insurance costs and reimbursements - and bureaucratic red tape. He agreed with me on that, too, with no grasp that his voting pattern over the decades helped create the problems. In my head:_ Yougottabekiddingme. _When it seemed to me that he didn't realize Baker City's maternity ward was still closed, he switched back to agreeing with me and knowing.
A day or two later, this article came out: [Oregon Sen. Ron Wyden's kids drove assistant to suicide with 'sexually explicit' behavior, homophobic slurs: lawsuit](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/M5cHza0IcBS3GvNuRE4_MA~~/AAAHURA~/6-LGbLULSGpIrjkpoo3sxrVKqoFuqfOyr7aFnXMt8ykD9iafg82lWSEML-0A0VrFdDGHEDLs7e52NnMnti9ZjOHs_7QI-YsdWDdUfcudilHwf0y1KoVQi_f6HPadYTW07lHqLoQg8s3PKIwGjM-nMHS8WcY8NcHKHCqfJlZEpY3cg3Mrvlq_VREdFgOkfL9DySTGh1Sd8KH7P-1dClGPSt6xRV9Pjkx8tyF8CGKruAxuSO4bP-9qiCNaqa688imRsjvqydRXy2Wn59khrRrhHpVpdP940FhDMLhzeUgjqNZ67QkzEjXT8rQ7LXIk1fau)
I'm aware of some buzz that a segment of his own party would like to pressure him out of office. He says he's running again. I guess we wait and see.
At midnight, Solomon and I crashed in Salem for a few hours, then headed back to Baker City where the Baker County Republican Women held a very successful fundraising banquet. As in, five figures worth of successful. More on that later.
Over and out.
_Kerry_

clean_body: | | | | | A Wonderful Marathon Week in D.C. Top L: Solomon Yue and Oregon's Judge Vance Day. Top R: Me in the DOJ library. Bottom L: Giving a press conference to an audience of four from AG Bondi's podium. Bottom R: Solomon with Peter Feaman. Misc. Meetings and the DOJ. Last week, Solomon and I traveled to Washington D.C. with a packed schedule for both Republicans Overseas (RO) and the Oregon Conservative Caucus (OCC). Almost daily, our meetings were scheduled nonstop from breakfast through late dinner. We now have a new HQ in the Georgetown area for RO, complete with a conference room, which we used several times. That was an early success. When we first arrived, we found that D.C. was in a state of flux with everyone changing their schedules to attend either a Charlie Kirk vigil or the memorial service. The President's UK trip also created for several changes. We met with a new RO chapter leader, started lining up keynote speakers for future OCC events, and discussed the CCP threat with State Department staff in light of Secretary Rubio's increased scrutiny on visa holders advocating for violence against us on our own soil. As everyone and their dog knows, ferreting out these creeps is Solomon's area of expertise, and Sec Rubio is as serious as a heart attack about stopping this kind of infiltration. We headed for the DOJ to say hi to Oregon's Judge Vance Day who serves as Senior Counsel to Todd Blanche, the Deputy U.S. Attorney General. That was more of a personal visit than anything because we've missed the guy! We obviously don't even know what kinds of "top secret" cases he's working on, but we know he's working nonstop and putting in some insane hours. He has a great office space, btw, filled with family photos and reminders of Oregon. He gave us a tour of part of the building, including the DOJ library, which I frankly could just live in for a few months and be happy. Transcripts from July 4, 1776? They're there. We did have some actual business to discuss in the building before heading for Harmeet Dhillon's office, but she'd been called out of town and we couldn't wait, so we just texted her instead. Next time. Solomon's longtime friend, Peter Feaman, whom Harmeet has tasked with handling "educational opportunities" inside the Civil Rights division, assures us that Oregon is high on their radar when it comes to boys in girls' sports. Peter took us into the hall where AG Bondi was sworn in, then up to the 7th floor to her press room. Maintenance staff turned on all the floodlights for me so I could stand on the stage behind her podium and conduct a "press conference." Cheesy? Yes! Would I do it again? Absolutely!!! Now I know what she's seeing whenever we watch her on TV. "Lovely to work with" was the comment we heard most often to describe her. We did hear a few times early in the week about some new "tamper-proof" Election Integrity (EI) paper ballot technology being developed at a national level, which would likely involve many agencies if it comes to fruition, so that sounded promising. Real EI efforts are happening at the federal level, by the way, not at dog and pony shows that bounce around on "tours," present false yet believable data, and accomplish nothing in the end. Do yourselves a favor and avoid listening to EI grifters; they've created a politically adjacent subindustry. Top L: On the steps of the Eisenhower Executive Office Building across from the side entrance to the West Wing. Top R: At the breakfast table every morning. Bottom L: One member of Congress gave us this challenge coin for our service to overseas Americans. Bottom R: 3.5 miles in 3" heels in the halls of Congress. I only made that footwear mistake once! | | WH, Congress, and Senate. Solomon and I took one of our RO Board Members and met with senior-level White House staff. What a great time we had inside the White House complex! Security was still touchy after the building having been on lockdown after September 10, but we were given a private tour of things like the Sec of War's conference room where Elon Musk and DOGE had set up shop. Staffers would see him wandering the halls at 2 a.m. because the guy doesn't sleep much when he's in the middle of a project. I can't get into a ton of detail, but we did talk about more EI regarding Oregon, various races, and what OCC is up to... I'm asked regularly on Facebook if the Trump Administration is aware of Oregon's issues, and the answer is 100% yes. Then it was back to RO business. There are three congressional buildings and three senate buildings - huge buildings with white tiles, wooden doors, and connecting tunnels. We had meetings every 30 minutes for three days straight in four of them. Each morning, we started at the Republican Capitol Hill Club Grill for breakfast with our team, then off we went to hit the halls. We ran into people we knew - like former Trump Campaign staff. Solomon ran into Jim Jordan. We have a very talented lobbyist/government affairs consultant on board, and have put together legislation, which we hope to get into the next budget rec package to end the double taxation of overseas Americans. If successful, we will right an injustice while fulfilling one of President Trump's campaign promises that didn't make it into the Big Beautiful Bill. (See his video here: I'll leave out the nitty gritty of the tax structure behind our pitch, but we met with the members in committees of jurisdiction and socialized the issue to them. The universal response to us walking in with a complete solution rather than a problem was incredibly positive. We were told that Speaker Johnson had just started putting out feelers about a Big Beautiful Bill Part Deux, so if that happens, our timing may be perfect. The Long Flight Home. Long story short, Solomon and I were seated with Sen. Ron Wyden for seven straight hours between delays on the tarmac and the flight itself. Sen. Jeff Merkley was somewhere behind us. I really questioned what it was that God wanted me to learn from that situation. I joked that I guessed this must be bipartisan seating, and Wyden took cautious minute to size up the situation. We all stayed cordial and treated each other like human beings, but it's safe to say I agree on NOTHING with this man. That's why it struck me so odd that he would nod and agree with everything I said! And with everything everyone else said! No matter what it was! I watched him at the gate and the gate staff knew him as a regular, so clearly he does return to Oregon at least sometimes. He told me he takes that flight every couple weeks, and I sensed that might be an exaggeration. His family lives in NY and his "developmentally challenged" daughter attends a private school there, he said. He also has a home in Portland, but shifted the conversation to how much time his family spends at the airport. So, I didn't discover anything people don't already know. He has been in office since 1981, and my take was that he lives to have people recognize him in public. He thought he'd helped the health care situation in Baker County mightily, btw - uh, no. "I brought in the experts!" he said. I mentioned insurance costs and reimbursements - and bureaucratic red tape. He agreed with me on that, too, with no grasp that his voting pattern over the decades helped create the problems. In my head: Yougottabekiddingme. When it seemed to me that he didn't realize Baker City's maternity ward was still closed, he switched back to agreeing with me and knowing. A day or two later, this article came out: I'm aware of some buzz that a segment of his own party would like to pressure him out of office. He says he's running again. I guess we wait and see. At midnight, Solomon and I crashed in Salem for a few hours, then headed back to Baker City where the Baker County Republican Women held a very successful fundraising banquet. As in, five figures worth of successful. More on that later. Over and out. Kerry Past Newsletters ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ * ~ | | The podcast is picking up listeners and advertisers! Hosted by the President’s Office at Wofford College, the SC Sister Senators who bridged together to fight for women’s rights in South Carolina, will join us for a special panel session moderated by the Honorable Former Representative Rita Allison with a foreward by Susu Johnson. Doors open at 5:30pm and a screening of their new documentary film trailer will follow the panel.

# Check out my latest podcast with Sen Margie Bright-Matthews
---
[|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=d5eec710db&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |
South Carolina Senator Margie Bright Matthews joins me to expose how partisan politics at the South Carolina State House endangers citizens, speaking as one of only two women in the South Carolina Senate. She discusses the fight against extreme abortion bans and threats to reproductive rights, plus a healthcare crisis driven by Medicaid cuts, rural hospital closures, and rising maternal mortality rates. Senator Bright Matthews reveals how cultural war issues distract from critical needs in education, infrastructure, and healthcare access in South Carolina. She explains how gerrymandering and Republican primaries create a Democratic super-minority, leaving South Carolina families as political pawns. The conversation covers actionable steps citizens can take to defend reproductive freedom.
---
| [Listen Up](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=c70101c957&e=edbde6c9b1)

Interested in phone banking for my campaign this Fall? Join us the third Thursday evening of each month for a virtual phone bank training! This is a great opportunity to volunteer on your own time and help my race for County Council. Remove exceptions for rape, incest, or fatal fetal anomaly. Redefine embryos as full legal persons, threatening contraception, IVF, and miscarriage care. Impose felony penalties up to 30 years on physicians and medical providers. Criminalize helping someone travel out of state for abortion care. Senator Bright Matthews reveals how cultural war issues distract from critical needs in education, infrastructure, and healthcare access in South Carolina. She explains how gerrymandering and Republican primaries create a Democratic super-minority, leaving South Carolina families as political pawns. The conversation covers actionable steps citizens can take to defend reproductive freedom. | | | Knock doors with me on Saturdays & Sundays | | Join me every Saturday at 10am & this Sunday at 11am for a neighborhood canvass to support my race for Spartanburg County Council! . Interested in phone banking for my campaign this Fall? Join us the third Thursday evening of each month for a virtual phone bank training! This is a great opportunity to volunteer on your own time and help my race for County Council. Remove exceptions for rape, incest, or fatal fetal anomaly. Redefine embryos as full legal persons, threatening contraception, IVF, and miscarriage care. Impose felony penalties up to 30 years on physicians and medical providers. Criminalize helping someone travel out of state for abortion care. Gag doctors and advocates from sharing accurate medical information — even online. | | | | | | | CONGRESS IS BACK—KEEP THE PRESSURE ON With Congress back in session, constituent pressure matters more than ever. Call, email, and show up at town halls to demand action and accountability on our core priorities. We need to hold members to clear, public positions. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | This past week I joined 19 women in the 2025 Emerge SC Cohort for their communications training workshop and welcomed Emerge America CEO Ashanti Gholar to Charleston. We have two women from Spartanburg in this year’s class and we have three incredible women from South Carolina on the national leadership team! Emerge has 1,200 women now serving in elected office. With 400+ victories in 2024, more than any other organization nationwide—it's a good time to support Last night I attended the SC Women in Leadership dinner to celebrate rising star Michelle Brandt, founder Barbara Rackes, and Coach Dawn Staley. name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zj5emg3936s7e0sah98vn0ur4rtj34fjipapirt0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
Friend,Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us.And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today.Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z0idr276somlqvtug11ho70qnojr2ctm8kfi1bro_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️To give you perspective, Friend...Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z87nl517id9qilu3c9hpe7cpbklv0ii5cf5lr1f8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
He always believed this day would come.He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.And more beautiful than we can even describe.**Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: **✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zn4u1mhsci5i5u7l1dsa433hkav2nb6mhidms9sg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z0opapklrjo1gi4963bpmfi7mvcm3l2elu1n8fk8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsaosqubt89089ooornf61o9lchat1dbn50th9l8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt3kkk7pu1tim5vl87frvppg4r54kvkca5s2r8ig_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znoh8sm8bbl0cc96q6qd4b8vrabg462v2rprpvj8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrb1f1hr4jvvnbnas72rtb9ibrj1598kqlvo0re8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs86tfrbu08b4r9ld75jjdog9lv4u5bn3utau838_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
Also...**Here 's one more powerful thing you can do:**📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew -- or any young person in your life -- who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter...**Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zg33h10q1nqatp08ac0hn6cunhgdiphtp8irvlpo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated...If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week...If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...**Thank you.** We can never say it enough.If you've read this far, we want you to know this...**You 're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. **God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers.Charlie would have wanted you to pray first -- and if that's all you can give today, _we 're grateful._But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor...And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible.**Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zq5unni9otk3akm1a43opnos4h0h2m34dvbd8tv0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.**God is so good.** 🙏
---
4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

Pop Acta Media | Your America
---
_PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522_

---
| | Friend,
I’m Kendall Qualls, a Conservative outsider running for governor of Minnesota to defeat far-left Democrat Tim Walz and stop his dangerous, radical agenda.
**[Before you read any further, I have to ask,**_will you chip in $25, $50, or anything you can today to help me win this critical race?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zujm33lttl73b1fue79cqbq74gm3cmjnm93i1bpo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)**

| | Walz’s record is a warning for America: **higher taxes, bigger government, weaker public safety, and divisive social policies.**
If he wins again, Democrats will point to Minnesota as proof their radical playbook works, and copy it in other states.
**I know what real opportunity looks like because I’ve lived it.** From growing up in poverty to serving as a U.S. Army officer to leading in the private sector, I’ve never been part of the political establishment. _I’m ready to take it on._
This race isn’t just about Minnesota. **It’s about proving Conservative leadership can still win, even in a blue state.**
But to do that, I need a national wave of support right now.
**If Conservatives across America rally behind this campaign, we can shock the political class, flip Minnesota red, and send a message the left will never forget.**
**_[Will you chip in a donation to support our campaign today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4og5l6pa34tujqfdjkv9ptesaqavl8secs2vvao_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)_**

[DONATE $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfatee16dbfr2t4odgeipo8qe3umblm8g2udq4pg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
[DONATE ANY AMOUNT](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zapf5o3lmbsjsr98dlfaf21rdoc994ab4tfavj2g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
| | Thank you for standing with me in this fight.
Sincerely, Kendall Qualls
Candidate for Governor of Minnesota

---
|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaj0hd759b9ftc45n1vnslq3bvcq83o72l7ebmng_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
---

My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. [Can I count on your support today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr7hnt3128oq8fcdtp4ml32u6a48to5vijo31qpg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie2ob6clh2bs)
With gratitude,Kendall Qualls

# VIRGINIA'S HONEY BADGER
---
| Dear Hello Vote in person before Tuesday, November 4. Early voting in person is already in progress. It will determine your quality of life for the next 4 years.
Will we be a red state or a blue state? Will we be a free state or an oppressed state? NOW is your opportunity to make a difference.
The 2024 statewide elections for Governor, Lieutenant Governor and Attorney General are currently underway. State House races and some local races are also on the ballot.
You can vote now at your registrar's office during regular business hours. Sample ballots are available online and at your local registrar's office. Please click[ here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dqBtySMdeErzW3vU_Zto43J3D75g5zKTnxfDVMllt4v4lErAjV0dkKXM5PX9hAciw9RZ1n_8v98YRnVbHqRV5ENa_18CTlVXahdMDViiEq-bXKOA3i2QLuT3ETIrW24Gb7y4jY6urAG1UlH-2O5fwpuu6AaopX9p-NgOTxPDtfQ=&c=DhbTFFkrVHm6XNg7k8Tp61NyZ-ZkPAVdd__8a4iGumL8OhES3up0nQ==&ch=0BETnDmKWIHtw8oBXgaip61X6PpfrNifMxa6UY40_OJVi_4xLBDW6A==) for more information on voting.
First, vote. Then, chip in any amount to continue receiving The Honey Badger Report.
By chipping in to support The Honey Badger Report, you will get the latest on the results of the November Elections and a daily and weekly report on key bills that impact you during the 2026 General Assembly Legislative Session. Most importantly, you will receive an action plan of what you can do on a daily basis to influence legislation in real time.
I know you want to make a difference, but you have so much going on in your life right now. I want to show you how to make a difference in a short period of time.
Let me help you navigate through all of the countless emails, and simply cut to the chase on what you can do to take action, action, action.
You and your family can follow key legislation passing through the General Assembly this January 2026.
Learn how to speak in favor or against bills remotely and in real time before Senate and House committees. I'll show you how to do so from the comfort of your own living room.
I know how Richmond works. And I want to use that knowledge to help you hold those you elect accountable. Having served in the Virginia Senate for 8 years, who better to keep you informed?
My mission is to give you the tools that will educate you, inform you and most importantly, show you how to best take action.
My heart is to continue to provide a free publication to those who are interested.
However, if you are able to and would like to support the Honey Badger Report with either a one time donation or regular monthly donation, I would love to partner with you to make sure Virginia government works for the people.
Will you partner with me?

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zghkeh2djkohdesj4ol662orhp4f6114ftem6di8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
Friend,Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us.And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today.Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmp1por74igtuae9frvdor79r2uo43f8s7d2bua0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️To give you perspective, Friend...Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z49ku4bm0su7v6a7lnhblg6icp5tecp9q7plfb7g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
He always believed this day would come.He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.And more beautiful than we can even describe.**Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: **✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znuvggmnvam9f1t115e4jto82r983eroena0uru8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0m2mo9nhrc5kheufoi1gfti0h1qspn1a790ag70_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zss3dmlbhi1k7af1d300ji969v51dbo7lrlkdgj8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqo2fmak63v8bh8qdu1r3et6je80r4ro5i7fj0d0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqs78bejreimi6ne3kum4k91ijepvnphdvq52q8g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3p82nr6pujofa9atd54jnicsij2orgtrb8g4qio_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlsmevql7nqitt6vfditnuj1ad884miinman31no_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
Also...**Here 's one more powerful thing you can do:**📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew -- or any young person in your life -- who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter...**Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1ukpus23j513bk7plpl68862va4es71rr1qmfhg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated...If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week...If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...**Thank you.** We can never say it enough.If you've read this far, we want you to know this...**You 're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. **God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers.Charlie would have wanted you to pray first -- and if that's all you can give today, _we 're grateful._But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor...And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible.**Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd54tf9ahtihk74h0i9dgg3fd7849k6qk0f795l0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stie1o32c1h2bs)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.**God is so good.** 🙏

Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, " What can I do?"As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: ✅ Leadership materials ✅ Pocket Constitutions ✅ Chapter training tools ✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... this won 't be a small task. But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. For Charlie. And here 's how YOU can help with this... Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter... How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started? Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... This is it. Also...Here 's one more powerful thing you can do:📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew -- or any young person in your life -- who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter...Please send them this link: Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated...If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week...If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...Thank you. We can never say it enough.If you've read this far, we want you to know this...You 're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. God is so good. For Charlie, -The Turning Point USA Family P.S. Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers.Charlie would have wanted you to pray first -- and if that's all you can give today, we 're grateful.But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor...And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible.Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter. Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.God is so good. 🙏 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 Pop Acta Media | American Action News PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

In today's _Et Cetera_ section, we’re featuring a [fun optical illusion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGv2yAUhX8N3ogAQ4gHhi7eXteOFobr5PbdgAs3sfzvq1epS9eu5xwdffp-fCwfEQnL_Xt8QuCtLgWOTsAMbekFd2iROabPjgneWDje4flajDJOqkkat-SIdC52yGEDMDAOELR3Nz85NV6HR8jg05ThZpJf1dVHp_U2bdoZrX3e7Dpg-HpTk3FaaTW6i82rsvnmnb2Ndl2TsAoycm2XnxULP2Cjs76hXVJ9DhQezHsX4zdhZmHm4zguqUFkfMNK9dfXSJj5bySx9B1bZKxFmLnujCmSRKJXx1q6MHOuzKf8t5F9j-2zywyE9wdvL6JTFmj5lBnWyCBrkalSfbWhhbwfSIT96oVV92dE-gPL_2X4HczvAAAA__-cT5Xk) that has viewers debating what they see. Do the dots look purple, blue, or something else? Reply to this email and tell us. [HeartSciences](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGPnDAQBeBfY7pdGRsbU1AkOm13aVNagz0sk2CD7IHT_fuIjRQp9dXv04ze-_nu34FWys8fkHDkefMZP-qKzFh8zbRjAWYIvysFPCkzPDEdXkllbnK4KeMj0PrpuyaOM6JC3eDY9sb1g5HaNssY7aD6CR22wdrWOokTWG3n6MBIgLmh8bomB2Va2Upt7l2cZBddbzqnu2kKopMYibdy_7VR5gXn9XM7sdzDlpp1XJj3KvQ3oR5CPSifWPm-IBSugTAHrBe8Uv04OPm6HSWg0G-YgFahLKRd6O9XlDDSkYR-24HibYfCGUtdaP9PBUg70DO_3D_SOnnTRvu_qxyZGLxyrneDUtK1TRnj_kHrStX2opPP6_mrAX9p9nNUfwIAAP__ExeXdg), today's sponsor, has already secured FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and is developing a game-changing AI platform poised to transform the $30B ECG market. ## Sniper Opens Fire at Dallas ICE Office
At least one migrant detainee was killed and two were critically wounded [after a sniper opened fire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdJx8i41x4SIN3aVNiYy9wCYGI7zH6f4-Ir-QbqQZvdHM12N4eEq0zZ9-RcdTHjZ8lYTMeAxlox0Pz-zDT6GAJ23sZ1yfA0jQtbQ16CF6Su9BVdFNiIBNhe5udGeslk1bLU6qMHZjbDs92oBjZ9EaCGCUnYxpZVuRu2jSgr7Lu2z0TcVRqtgZrbpGjWMQSmIkzsftO9PGC07pnU88biGvVXIL815E8yGgF9Bv7z0XviwB_QUW0Et7aSWgf5b62iegjz4lX2oKWJclZ6ZtrhOdWD_36BmvSHW4uL8oJSqtEUrOq6f0V8r_eup08BsAAP__Bmx7pA) on their transport van outside an ICE facility in Dallas early Wednesday, authorities said. The shooter, identified as [29-year-old Joshua Jahn](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyszAQhJ8GOjFCSAYKFX_jzn-bkjmhk3WOQB50NuHtMySPkHZ3Zne-7-M23YASrff_sKDlkKcV95KQGbeprPTEDZhh_iw045tWhjsur0lJZYQchTKTB0rHpGtvA6LCrkbb9mboRyO7Sx2t106b4MIcXN-GQQ2902YcVCelURftarLnmhyVaWUrO9No76T2Q2_00Gnn5kpL9MR5ax6ZVo4Y0pHfuDVzXupkI_OzVN2_Sl0rdd33vQn566Q4-0pdX-WMYxaPXOILxAPiKkrMmXETHsGnQ3hICYqgGUWAmRLxIX656836504pUbn0lZb3BSj9PPOfdL2t-g4AAP__WP6A5Q), fired from a rooftop and died of a self-inflicted gunshot as police closed in. FBI officials say “anti-ICE” was scrawled on bullets found near his body, and a car linked to him displayed a map referencing nuclear fallout zones. [No ICE agents were injured](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFutSAUhJ8Gdxo8gOiCxZ_8cXe7aZouDcJBT4tihHtv7ts39hW6mkwmmcx8n7fpZinSvrzZDU0JadrxmSOWgueUdzrwtKVY953J4YP2Yhfc7hNwUDUfalCTtxRfk6y8CYiAokLTatXrQXHRVasZNO_Qt3MAC50KrZdeDn3nNAgQs-QVmauND6Ba3nKhGulnLn2vleyFnGfHJEdPJZ3NV6K9rBjiKz3wbFzaqmjWUo7MxD8GI4PRzu560CzpihmMH-8Mxu0eCx0R6wPTJXlNpfY2RptrclgHwujrFMJlcrqfDhmMuaTzxcRInon_Lai-10J31Wn88aQYKXeaSb5sluLvlvIngA8DPwEAAP__GJ2EQg) in the attack. The FBI is treating the incident as targeted violence—the third shooting aimed at federal immigration sites since July.
## NASA Plans Crewed Moon Flight for February
NASA said it's targeting [February 2026 for Artemis II](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp8GuzGIoFJQ_I3d_O2WBOHi3F0Ug3c17tNvnFfY7ktOcpLvfDzt02HCdf7vFjAUs13h3BMQQbH7ihsUR-T8144eDlzJzbB8W8GFenD9EMoGh-mysgomAghoKzBNr4ZeK9521csMUWmI3aCbVstOqMZ1rnvjqKMOUKG5bVwL1fCGt6qWYeIyDL2SQyunyTPJISDlUn9mXOkFMV35gFL7vFTJvIi2nbX_mBiZGM_zrKfJ34yJ8T7DxOgKoU9wT3_1G8zHT9NfuSombCemhHvXM8nnxWF6W-lPKQ4jfgMAAP__WA9yWw), the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years. Four astronauts—three from NASA and one from Canada—will spend 10 days circling the Moon aboard the Orion spacecraft to test systems critical for future lunar landings. Watch a [short video about the mission](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M9uszAQBPCnMbcg4z-YHHz4pE8oUpX22NzQGi9hW4Mj2IDy9hV9hV5nRr_DfF67K1Ci-f4OE3oecjfjviZkxqVbZ3rgAszQf6_U40Yzwx2nZ6eksid5PinbRaD06kwR_YCoUBfoK2cbd7ZS18XoA9hQOTuoOsJQOQgSNJja9YOOzTEhf2jyrGwlK6ltaWKQJjbOmkabEHphJEbivJRfmWYecUivvOFS9nkqkh-ZH6vQ_4RqhWr3fS9f-cnPgEd_JMD9KHS7Cf3_DevbrWkvH5drsfj42CklWmsnjLxPQOmX5D_9sHn1EwAA__9iX3Ee). The mission will fly farther into space than any humans have gone before—nearly 5,000 miles past the Moon—aiming to pave the way for a lunar landing as part of Artemis III, though experts say the [2027 target for that mission](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOnDAQBuCngW6Q19iHKVykobu0KdFgD4sTYyN7dglvH3HKG1z3STP69ev_9Tl_YoghPX_iTpbXPCc6ayRmKnNN4aCCzOj-1ODoHRLjk_bXLIXUIEaQevYY4jWr1tuVSFLfkn0M2gyjFv1Hu9lVu5HGZTQe9WIGFEav3gxCOjWS7E0b7J0mRqkf4iF63Sm_COXNoJXp1bK4RgnygXPpfueQeKM1XvlNpXN5b6PdmI_a9D8aOTVyOs-zqwc6uq-NnL4M9PeIuSCHnBo5YWHaQ70Fa8mJoeQTKiEDZ9hC5VwuSFixwv9fkLDnnOqWGVx-RQ8RX8ltgBUIS7xurLSAbov1xxliDPVjaJR47hjiV1X-1r5vK_8FAAD__wvgksA) is viewed as optimistic. Final testing on the crew capsule and rocket system is underway at Kennedy Space Center. Watch the Artemis II [crew discuss the mission here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GuomMwQkUFNuke9tuiQZ7CLPP2MgzhM3fr5JfeN2Vju7V1fnzNX0hR06P37jRqEueEp0SSZXKJIl3KqiK_lvY05OT4oO2Y7LGOjADWDcF5PiaujqMC5Gltqaxubn-NjjTXut1dGT70BCibRea3ZUcNvMw2KFHpMF2NY_vNTNY15jGtO7Shdl0ob-5rm-7efZVZyiw5nL5mznpSkt85SeVi89bHcdVdZeq_VXZe2Xv53leZEdPb1rZ-ycD_dtjLqicU2Xv67Fhgg9ZIj9WffdQ_QoJBQFTykfyBKwCiU5A0ZITHgo-oghgChBY_CECuhJgUdpYwMKWc4KNRTgn0JUFTqLvuoxhPzlGluut6sxjQ46f9_oj5c_R_g8AAP__LyGbHw)
## Federal Spending Soars to $6.8 Trillion
A new chart shows [U.S. federal spending jumped](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAQRk9jOiPjH8CFizR0mzYlsvHATmIMwrOgvX1ErpD--96T3tdjfHhMmJdPv4KjeRszXCUBERxjybjD4Yn89FNwghMz-QXW1yiFNFxYLs0YPab3qKvoZgAJqgLXdKbvrBGqrZ6uE6oNbdMqKxX02ggLMAcbQquMV76p0N00YaVpRCOUqXUMQse-M7pXOoSJaQERaTvq7w0zPWFO7-2Eo562tUruSbQXpj6YHJgcruuqTywvnya_I_mEhe4hk8O0Mzm8Cl_uc14hEy875Ih54Y3tBT8Lpy36N5NDdbi4X5gSlrZjWiyrx_QnpH9VOp38DQAA__9IpHxr) from $2.3 trillion in 1980 to $6.8 trillion in 2024, inflation-adjusted. Social Security, Medicare, and debt interest saw the biggest hikes. Federal spending nearly tripled, though the population grew just 50%. The [national debt has surged](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSrCAQANDTYKaFDQwaEPzEbH66oYXQOr2DYGHvWHP7rd0r7AVe8D7u891Torz99zs6Xsuc8ToTMmOdz0wHVs_sw_OkgC_K7Dfcv2aQYFo5tmDm6Cm9Z91EtyICqgZdb81gRyPVrXm41VqLw2D0aGMADGYBaUeJ0CsZBoUNuR9NjmB62UtlOh0XqeNgjR6UXpYgtMRIXGr3WSjzA9f0Li-sXSh7k9yD-TiF-idgEjBd19Ud27F2pW4CpuyZSvapjbhwG1IJTwFTU108LkqJzpsVWm67p_TL8Z8OXg6-AwAA__9xTnAX) to $37.4 trillion, or about $110,000 per person, with daily interest costs nearing $3 billion.

subject: Dallas ICE Shooting, Shelley Duvall's Home For Sale, and 30,000 Bees
body:
A shooting at the Dallas ICE field office on Wednesday morning killed one detainee and wounded two others. No officers were injured, and the suspected gunman—identified as 29-year-old Joshua Jahn—died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

| | |
---
| [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkEGOozAQRU8Du6BygcEsvIhmxGzCSKNZ9BIZqghWF3GEnZDcvkVfodf_6T_pffRD77z42_WvW9mm1xyGG-9ROCXeBnIiLvqJ4xJC8rdrXFiE3zQgoD5Be0I9kPPyHqqc7AjUqpytarRpWqPQ5IttStZNy0hUT05VZoZag4K6UfOExoy5t8cZtKiVAoSqKA1qqKCaR1CGqMkqYPIpbEVaOPHLxVne4clbMYU1F7ukdI9Zec6wy7Db971woyCk7fMAMuzw8u9XeWwX_afvy4Mruxge28SDp6z8Pcv6iImYUP_nO-pzvlm6717Ex_rwX1fn5VuXfhbpafErAAD__xy_eM0) | |
# Thursday, September 25, 2025
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1926, [Jack Hyles](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQgOGngS3oOHAwg4cuqKqUrh0tG5_hlAuOsJWEt6_SV-j4L9_w_1zsxbHwtny7G5nyislu9MxCpdBugxNxmWfKa0qFtyWvJEJHsAioTjCeUNngWA7b18F4CGNbk2kHpYdRt6jr1XSeAngVfYTZkVLewzz4zimK2p_7rmbzxmBE1baA0DedRgU99NFDq0MYqh4ocEl7U1Yq9HI5ypEetDdzutVi1lLuueo-KpwqnGhrnnzlOwV2TdqXCqd3Vzh9uflqPw-hXO8m3J8swvn85pebY_nTyv8ePAz-BgAA__-sEXFh) was born in Italy, Texas. After attending East Texas Baptist University in Marshall, he became the pastor of First Baptist Church of Hammond in Indiana in 1959. Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us. And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:

**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.

He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: ** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

| ***New Media Spotlight***
Treasurer Goldberg's Chief of Staff 'Peaces Out' to Charlie Kirk's Death in Private Post
---
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
PRESS CONTACT: Mark Steffen, [mark@massgop.com](mailto:mark@massgop.com)
BOSTON, MA -- New media reporters in Massachusetts are continuing to uncover a disturbing pattern of behavior by public employees who appeared to celebrate the assassination of Charlie Kirk on September 10.
On Thursday, [Jack Gately reported](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eu8WNDxvpXBpgvwUBBxA0cqGq4WbZB1UG9tlXqMVsUpUk5n0y0LMyXOT9KPhRvTQH6FtjGbSSNMZPaY9O2hwP5xXe7WRO8dhxFN_fmYI2XEjpKYkb-TIoEvyW9Rut04Fs4UtThnAPt3165oboOf2mm6Mlcfyzibmayzv87ecns7fvgcuF_fNcxh7-2dqiVDbxEol9NaDXUoiHXCLWiQs-g==&c=DHtEMVic2O4P8o1Ru95wJW2gqDYoaHi27sRSJ8QsvUrXm-CA11hf_w==&ch=Io2gejZZRFKxceptOyt31FXTbSJGEZxdFtEaE5IJ61YXvNrwrLU0nw==) that Chandra Bork, Chief of Staff to State Treasurer Deborah Goldberg, photographed herself in a private story on Instagram where she gives the universal "peace out" sign over her forehead. Beneath it, she displays a 2023 Newsweek article headlined "Charlie Kirk says gun deaths 'unfortunately' worth it to keep 2nd amendment."
The source of the image suggests Bork posted the cavalier anti-Kirk message around 8 p.m. on September 10, five hours after he was shot and killed.
"Violence has no place in civilized discourse, but its celebration should be equally abhorred in Massachusetts' halls of power. This is just the latest instance of actions taken by the office of Treasurer Goldberg politicizing what should be a nonpartisan and apolitical office. Mocking the death of commentators is never acceptable," said MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale.

# Sisters caught destroying Charlie Kirk memorial now begging for money after losing jobs
Kerri, 23, and Kaylee Rollo, 22, **[were arrested on September 17 for vandalizing](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7674f1-7d67-4a95-b7bf-b6044245daab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a Charlie Kirk memorial at the Benton County Courthouse in Arkansas, where they were filmed destroying candles and signs while shouting profanities and giving middle fingers to the camera.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7674f1-7d67-4a95-b7bf-b6044245daab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Benton County Sheriff's Office
* **Personal consequences and job losses** : After their arrest, Kerri was fired from her restaurant job and Kaylee was dumped by her boyfriend and kicked out of his mother's home, with the mother stating she "will not allow someone living in my home to be OK or celebrate a murder."
* **GoFundMe campaign amid backlash** : The sisters launched a GoFundMe seeking $18,000 for legal fees, claiming their First Amendment rights were violated and they were being "doxxed online," though they raised nearly $15,000 with some donations appearing to come from trolls leaving critical comments.
* **Legal charges and community response** : Both sisters were charged with first-degree criminal mischief and released on $22,500 total bond, while Benton County Justice of the Peace Joseph Bollinger emphasized that while people have free expression rights, "you're trampling on the memory of a person" when destroying memorials.

* * *
# New info on Charlie Kirk shooter's transgender boyfriend paints a strange picture...
**Abrupt shift led to family expulsion:** Lance Twiggs, 22, was a gifted pianist with straight A's at an accelerated magnet school for high achievers, but **[was kicked out by his strict Mormon parents](https://substack.com/redirect/8284d87a-062a-4f5b-b0db-4a61cd33fe19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as a minor--with disputed reasons ranging from rejecting their faith to alleged drug use and disrespectful behavior.

---|---|---
Amy Twiggs/Facebook
* **Online gaming lifestyle and relationship** : After being homeless and couch-surfing, Twiggs moved into a townhouse owned by his parents and became the live-in boyfriend of Tyler Robinson, with both men reportedly becoming consumed by online gaming, digital fantasy worlds, and involvement in "furry" subcultures.
* **Key evidence in assassination case** : Court documents revealed that Robinson confessed to killing Charlie Kirk in text messages sent to Twiggs during the 33-hour manhunt following the September 10 assassination, with Twiggs later sharing these communications with law enforcement.
* **Current cooperation with authorities** : Twiggs has not been charged with any crime and is reportedly cooperating with police in the investigation, though his current whereabouts are unknown and neighbors report mail piling up at the couple's former shared residence.

Look, Derek, I’m not losing sleep over the fact that Donald Trump thinks I’m a “bad guy” or "among the worst” Democrats. And I’m sure as hell not going to hesitate to call out his administration for their corruption, chaos, and downright incompetence. But here’s what I _am_ worried about: **Trump’s allied super PACs are paying attention, and they have their marching orders now.** This is how it goes – first Trump attacks you, then the super PACs swoop in. And frankly, with control of Congress on the line, I’ve got to be prepared for my toughest and most expensive campaign yet. **That’s why I called my campaign manager and increased our fundraising goals for the quarter. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
BOSTON, MA -- Massachusetts Republican Party Chair Amy Carnevale on Friday called for State Treasurer Deborah Goldberg to resign, citing the millions of dollars wasted in her lawsuit brought by Cannabis Control Commission Chair Shannon O'Brien and wasteful spending in other areas of her office.
Goldberg was previously told by a state judge that she committed "clear error" in accusing O'Brien of gross misconduct, but chose to continue appealing O'Brien's wrongful termination suit until it became obvious that she had no viable path forward.
The "bricks" of Goldberg's case against O'Brien, the judge concluded, were as "thin as playing cards."
"Treasurer Goldberg has been in office 11 years, and in that time she has managed to turn a thriving arm of state government into the capital of out-of-state junkets and Cadillac catering. Her lackluster defense for firing Commissioner O'Brien is just the tip of the iceberg," said MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale. "Since it's not her money, she doesn't care.
"There is a pattern of apparent negligence and disregard, from junkets and holiday meals to credible reports of nepotism in her office. She abused her position by allowing cronyism and waste to flourish.
"It's no wonder why Republicans are eager to introduce a serious challenger for the Office of State Treasurer in 2026."
Some of the Treasurer's most outrageous bills include:
* $4,700 spent by the Lottery in 2025 for high-end dining at The Chateau
* A record $62,000 spent on out-of-state travel in 2025
* Over $385,000 spent on supplemental salaries in 2025 to match manager pay with union pay increases

name: Courtney Brady, Evergreen
subject: Do you support farmers' rights to use their land for clean energy?
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
This isn't just a climate issue—it's a property issue.
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4017679/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi friend,

Between increasingly unpredictable weather events affecting crop production and rising input costs, American farmers face many challenges. Fortunately, renewable energy is a huge opportunity. Think: Farmers leasing their land for energy infrastructure that could power _thousands_ of homes.

Yet despite the affordability and strong public support for these projects, local red tape and misinformation are preventing them from getting off the ground. As a result, clean energy projects are being blocked faster than they’re being built.

**Not only is this a climate issue, but also a property rights issue.**

Ultimately, rural landowners want the freedom to decide what’s best for their property, the ability to support their families, and the opportunity to pass on their way of life to future generations. **And leasing their land for clean energy infrastructure helps make all of that possible** —like a way to add another “crop” that generates revenue and is temporary, especially if some of their land is no longer well-suited for farming in the short term.

This year, Evergreen will be advocating for state-level policies that affirm rural landowners’ right to lease their land for clean energy, ensure that permitting processes don’t block responsible development, and keep communities involved without unnecessary red tape. [**Can we count on you to be by our side in this fight?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4017680/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4017681/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Across the country, farmers are navigating shifting economic pressures—from declining crop commodity prices and rising operating costs to labor shortages and increasingly unpredictable weather conditions that are making growing more challenging. In response, many are exploring new, voluntary revenue streams like leasing land for solar infrastructure that help keep their land family-owned and their operations profitable.

But too often, that opportunity is blocked by misinformation, outdated zoning rules, and politically motivated restrictions. In many cases, **farmers and rural landowners are being told what they can’t do with their own land, even when proposed projects meet all environmental and safety standards.**

We believe that empowering property owners to make decisions about their land without unnecessary government interference is key to moving forward. And the way to do that is by advocating for clear, transparent siting and permitting reforms that honor community input while still supporting—rather than hindering—landowners’ rights. [**Do you agree?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4017682/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[YES, I'LL SIGN ON](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4017683/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---

This is my hail Mary...
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e16090213/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvdFkzcXQ5RzNiZQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MjU/LbmNsejFCdFc2Ng/qP2hpZHM9bmNSdlBTbGdndU1EbHhscw/gaNVB8g/s2o402ce16c)

| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Dear Patriot,
---
This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written.
---
I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 80-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right.
---
I’ve taken on mobsters. I’ve faced terrorists. I’ve battled corruption. I’ve been through it all.
---
_Or so I thought..._
---
**...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!
---
_No pardon.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill. _
---
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me: **_the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like _YOU_._**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) — calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.
---
[**Please help me reach this life-saving (_truly!_) goal today by immediately adding your name to “THE PEOPLE’S PARDON” as citizens unite to call for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES against me.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
__
---

[ADD YOUR NAME](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

Thank you and God bless you,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Rudy Giuliani
Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund

| Letter from the Chair
---
Leaders Always Needed: Step Up with the NEGOP
The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is calling for dedicated leaders--and those ready to become leaders--to shape the future of our state. Nebraska has a wealth of elected offices, ranging from Legislative Districts that require a significant commitment to boards and commissions with lighter time demands, and everything in between. These roles need passionate individuals to step forward and serve. Beyond elected positions, the NEGOP seeks leaders to drive County and State Party initiatives. In early 2026, County Conventions will elect representatives who, in turn, will choose State Party leadership at the State Convention. These opportunities are your chance to make a lasting impact.
What Makes a Great Leader? Countless books explore leadership, but here are five essential qualities we value:

1. Reluctant Leadership: Great leaders don't chase power for its own sake. They step up out of duty, driven by a desire to meet a need and serve others.
2. Servant Leadership: True leaders mentor, encourage, and uplift those around them. They prioritize the team's success over personal glory.
3. Rational Leadership: Effective leaders think critically, anticipate challenges, question processes, and craft thoughtful solutions to achieve shared goals.
4. Emotional Maturity: Confident but not arrogant, great leaders welcome constructive criticism with grace and use it to grow.
5. Principled Leadership: Anchored by strong moral, ethical, and spiritual values, these leaders act for the greater good, not for personal gain or recognition.

Why Step Up? Leadership roles are opportunities to grow, challenge yourself, and make a difference. Each new role builds on past experiences, creating a ripple effect of growth and impact. Your leadership strengthens families, communities, our state, and our nation. The NEGOP invites you to embrace the challenge. Whether you're a seasoned leader or ready to take your first step, Nebraska needs you. Join us now in seeking out elected office or at County Conventions in 2026 and beyond to shape a brighter future. Step up. Lead on.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Leaders Always Needed: Step Up with the NEGOP The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is calling for dedicated leaders--and those ready to become leaders--to shape the future of our state. Nebraska has a wealth of elected offices, ranging from Legislative Districts that require a significant commitment to boards and commissions with lighter time demands, and everything in between. These roles need passionate individuals to step forward and serve. Beyond elected positions, the NEGOP seeks leaders to drive County and State Party initiatives. In early 2026, County Conventions will elect representatives who, in turn, will choose State Party leadership at the State Convention. These opportunities are your chance to make a lasting impact. What Makes a Great Leader? Countless books explore leadership, but here are five essential qualities we value: 1. Reluctant Leadership: Great leaders don't chase power for its own sake. They step up out of duty, driven by a desire to meet a need and serve others. 2. Servant Leadership: True leaders mentor, encourage, and uplift those around them. They prioritize the team's success over personal glory. 3. Rational Leadership: Effective leaders think critically, anticipate challenges, question processes, and craft thoughtful solutions to achieve shared goals. 4. Emotional Maturity: Confident but not arrogant, great leaders welcome constructive criticism with grace and use it to grow. 5. Principled Leadership: Anchored by strong moral, ethical, and spiritual values, these leaders act for the greater good, not for personal gain or recognition. Why Step Up? Leadership roles are opportunities to grow, challenge yourself, and make a difference. Each new role builds on past experiences, creating a ripple effect of growth and impact. Your leadership strengthens families, communities, our state, and our nation. The NEGOP invites you to embrace the challenge. Whether you're a seasoned leader or ready to take your first step, Nebraska needs you. Join us now in seeking out elected office or at County Conventions in 2026 and beyond to shape a brighter future. Step up. Lead on. Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party | | | What's Happening: From the legislative desk of Jeanne Reigle... I'm excited to share that I've been actively exploring opportunities to advance the NEGOP's recently adopted legislative plan. My strategy includes drafting proposed legislation, organizing a potential legislative summit to drive our objectives, and hosting additional events at the party headquarters to strengthen ties with our Republican State Senators and their teams. I'm also excited that I have a meeting scheduled with Speaker Arch later this month to discuss these initiatives and move the NEGOP shared vision forward! Friend,
---
So many kind souls like you have asked how I’m doing, so I wanted to personally update you on my recovery.
---
I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed.
---
Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together.**
---
But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in America, I know I can survive **__ANYTHING!__**
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf8vphh6tmb09796700lcr27i56engvia740lg6g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3h68ob2cth2bs)
__
---
One thing especially helped take the pain away...
---
...**President Trump has announced that he will award me with the Presidential Medal of Freedom – _the highest civilian honor in America._**
---
**President Trump knows I’m in a dire situation right now. His pardon powers only apply to _federal_ cases, which means he _legally_ _cannot_ save me from the bogus _state-level_ charges brought against me by a radical Democrat Attorney General who is trying to imprison me for 20 YEARS.**
---
**Left with no pardon, no safety net, and no lifeline, my _ONLY_ chance at walking free is to secure a top-notch defense team.**
---
But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of **BANKRUPTCY**.
---
**And now, this car crash has set me back even more...**
---
And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like _YOU_.
---
That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I continue fighting for my _FREEDOM_ and my _JUSTICE_.
---
__Because when President Trump places the Medal of Freedom around my neck, I want history to always remember that I FOUGHT for my freedom and justice until the VERY END!__
---
