name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Some moments are too important for partisanship.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
You probably don’t read a lot of pieces written jointly by a Republican and a Democrat these days.
#

Team,
Some moments are too important for partisanship. The moment our country is in today is one of them.
I just wrote a new op-ed for USA Today with former Republican U.S. Senator Jeff Flake. It talks about the leadership we need to bring us out of this dangerous moment and where we go from here. I hope you’ll take a moment out of your day to read it.
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep25.vnrwKJ&refcode=em250925-1-b&t=1&akid=10905%2E3935704%2E9KI0qh)**

* * *
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep25.vnrwKJ&refcode=em250925-1-b&t=2&akid=10905%2E3935704%2E9KI0qh)
**We're a Republican and a Democrat. After Charlie Kirk's death, we agree on this.**
Gabby Giffords and Jeff Flake

September 2025
You probably don’t read a lot of pieces written jointly by a Republican and a Democrat these days. We served together in Congress, both representing districts in Arizona, until Gabby was nearly assassinated at an event with her constituents in 2011. When Gabby heroically returned to Congress for the 2012 State of the Union address, we bucked tradition and sat together, instead of sitting on opposite sides of the aisle with our respective parties.
Some moments are too important for partisanship. The moment our country is in today is one of them.
Since the attempt on Gabby’s life, political violence has raged across America. In 2017, a man targeted Republican Rep. Steve Scalise and others during a congressional baseball practice. In 2021, a political mob attacked police sworn to protect the U.S. Capitol while screaming to hang the vice president. One year later, a man broke into former Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s house and attacked her husband with a hammer.
Last summer, two unhinged individuals attempted to assassinate President Donald Trump. This June, an extremist shot and killed a Democratic former Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives, Melissa Hortman, and her husband. This gunman also wounded another lawmaker and his wife.
And on Sept. 10, an apparent sniper killed conservative activist Charlie Kirk at a public event on a Utah college campus. Jeff gave a speech on this same campus the day before Charlie Kirk was assassinated.
**Calls for 'war' and retribution have to stop now**
Already, extreme voices are attempting to hijack this debate. There are calls for “war” targeting progressive institutions and donors, and other frightening forms of collective punishment against the president’s critics. Meanwhile, there are radical individuals on the left celebrating the tragedy as an act of twisted political justice. Political violence of any kind, waged by government agents or external extremists, is a betrayal of our founding principles.
If we Americans allow ourselves to be dragged further down this path of violence and retribution, we will lose ourselves – and our country. We will abandon the pursuit of a more perfect union and descend into a frightening era where neighbors are suspicious, strangers are enemies and political opponents are threats who must be neutralized.
This dystopian future might feel good to social media warriors posting memes, but those of us who want our country to succeed know that letting ourselves be divided into extreme factions will be the end of the great American experiment of democracy.
There will always be disagreements in free societies. No matter where someone falls on the ideological spectrum, there will be people whose views they find to be wrongheaded, ignorant and morally repugnant, and sometimes the feeling is mutual.
In a democracy like ours, we all disagree sometimes, and that’s a good thing. We often disagreed when we served together, and we often learned from it. But disagreements must never become death sentences – if that happens, all of us are at risk, and so is our democracy.
**Bipartisanship is the only way forward to end gun violence**
As former members of Congress – one a Democrat and one a Republican – we believe there are two key approaches to halt the slide into violent factionalism.
First, we need sound leadership. That shouldn't be too much to ask for. Those with power and influence – from the president on down – must realize that fanning the flames of division will only make things worse and lead to even more violence and crime.
Kirk’s supporters are angry – we all are – but in this perilous moment, elected officials wield outsized influence on whether the justified anger at the assassin transforms into malice toward fellow Americans. At a moment when everyone seems on edge, irresponsible rhetoric or behavior from people in power has the potential to lead us down an even darker path.
Second, we need to talk about how astonishingly easy it is for violent extremists to assemble arsenals of guns to use against people whom social media characters and algorithms persuade them to hate. This isn’t about left or right, Democrats or Republicans. By now, we know all too well that murderous radicals of any political stripe can be a threat to anyone in the public sphere, as well as the innocent people around them.
Like the majority of Americans, we both support protecting the gun rights of responsible, law-abiding gun owners. But the stakes are too high to rely solely on the honor system – we need more effective background checks and "red flag" laws to remove guns from people who pose an imminent danger.
Decades from now, Americans will know how this generation of leaders responded in these trying moments. As former elected officials, we have learned that political careers are brief but that legacies last forever. In the wake of Charlie Kirk's horrific assassination, and following other concerning episodes of political violence in recent years, we hope politicians and commentators on all sides take a moment, put down the phone or push their chairs back from their computers, and seriously consider how all of our actions in the coming days and weeks will shape this country for future generations.
* * *

Please, take a second to read this...
As a victim of political violence, Gabby Giffords has led the fight to save more lives from gun violence for more than a decade, but she can’t do it alone.
If everyone reading this donated just $17, we'd have the resources to pass commonsense gun safety legislation across the country. But not everyone gives — making it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to pitch in what they can.
**If $17 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we're asking you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC today.**
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/61660?c0=giffords-em-sep25.Kx2kIW&refcode=em250925-1-b&t=3&akid=10905%2E3935704%2E9KI0qh)**

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=10905%2E3935704%2E9KI0qh) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Friend,
---
So many kind souls like you have asked how I’m doing, so I wanted to personally update you on my recovery.
---
I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed.
---
Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together.**
---
But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in America, I know I can survive **__ANYTHING!__**
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zjj3uv7rnmjv668m3oe5096h6lo5k4n5916mtk38_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3h64pj4c5h2bs)
__
---
One thing especially helped take the pain away...
---
...**President Trump has announced that he will award me with the Presidential Medal of Freedom – _the highest civilian honor in America._**
---
**President Trump knows I’m in a dire situation right now. His pardon powers only apply to _federal_ cases, which means he _legally_ _cannot_ save me from the bogus _state-level_ charges brought against me by a radical Democrat Attorney General who is trying to imprison me for 20 YEARS.**
---
**Left with no pardon, no safety net, and no lifeline, my _ONLY_ chance at walking free is to secure a top-notch defense team.**
---
But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of **BANKRUPTCY**.
---
**And now, this car crash has set me back even more...**
---
And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like _YOU_.
---
That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I continue fighting for my _FREEDOM_ and my _JUSTICE_.
---
__Because when President Trump places the Medal of Freedom around my neck, I want history to always remember that I FOUGHT for my freedom and justice until the VERY END!__
---
[**So, if you can, please make a contribution to the Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund to ensure I have the resources needed to retain a top-notch defense team in what is now the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom and justice.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ze5e9ssmg7ulubmriaaort2l66vv5ta6sudd43n0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0s3h64pj4c5h2bs)

Friend, what we're seeing right now should alarm every American.
The other day, a Fox News host suggested on live television that homeless people should be executed. We didn't hear a peep from Donald Trump.

In stark contrast, Trump openly celebrated that Jimmy Kimmel was forced off the air – and even threatened to strip broadcast licenses from networks that criticize him and his administration.

That's not free speech. That's authoritarianism. And it cannot stand.

**[Hey Peter, I’m Chris Deluzio, an Iraq War veteran and a Congressman representing my home district in Western Pennsylvania. And I’ve dedicated my life to serving this country.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95712?refcode=em20250925-9469&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9469%2E614464%2EhlHm7_)**

After the 9/11 attacks happened during my senior year of high school, I felt a call to serve. So I headed off to the Naval Academy as a teenager.
I served in the Navy—two deployments at sea, one on the ground in Iraq. I learned to put the mission first and those I served alongside ahead of myself. The motto was, “Ship. Shipmate. Self.” That same commitment drives me in Congress every single day to fight for my fellow veterans and the hardworking people of Western Pennsylvania.
But right now, Republicans in the House are threatening critical programs that so many Americans rely on—just so they can give a bigger piece of the pie to huge corporations and billionaires.
They’re bringing a chainsaw to the Social Security Administration and the VA, threatening the hard-earned benefits and care of millions of seniors and veterans. And now, they’re pushing a fiscally reckless plan that would cut billions of dollars from Medicaid, leaving millions of Americans without healthcare coverage.
My time in the Navy taught me to stand up for what’s right and to never shy away from a righteous fight for the hardworking people of our country. And I won't stop now.

body:
When voters gave Democrats here in Minnesota a trifecta in state government, they didn’t play it safe.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1847%2E791427%2EWCtvH4)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-sep25.9TUzdV&refcode=em250925-1-90&t=2&akid=1847%2E791427%2EWCtvH4)
Team — When voters gave Democrats here in Minnesota a trifecta in state government, they didn’t play it safe. They didn’t play by the rules of corporate special interests.
They passed bold legislation to help working Minnesotans thrive in an economy where the cost of living just keeps going up.
Universal, free school breakfasts and lunches is the kind of common sense program that everyone can get behind. For many working families, it has been a huge boost for their wallets and their child’s education.
And Democrats in Minnesota didn’t stop at school meals. They passed legislation on voting rights, workers’ rights, paid family and medical leave, green energy policies, and reproductive rights.
So here’s a simple lesson we should all remember: **The point of getting elected is to deliver results.**
Democrats’ path back to power relies on our ability to challenge the entrenched power of corporations and the mega-rich to create these kinds of significant changes in the lives of Americans.
Trump offered to lower the cost of living and turn this country around. **It was a lie.**
But if we don’t offer our own agenda — an agenda of big ideas that rises to the level of frustration and exasperation that working Americans feel every day — we will continue to allow Republicans to divide and conquer in election after election.
That’s the exact vision that Ilhan Omar fights for, and it’s the vision she brings to Congress. Ilhan has always pushed Democrats to embrace ideas like universal healthcare, tuition-free college, and paid family and medical leave.
**[If you agree that Democrats need to reject corporate special interests and fight for bold policies to lift up America’s working class, consider chipping in to Ilhan’s campaign today. I was 9 years old, and that right there was my first computer. I was hooked from the start. The logic, the problem-solving, the chance to build something from nothing — it lit a fire in me. What I didn’t know back then was just how far that passion would take me. **That kid — sitting in front of a screen, teaching himself to code — never imagined he’d go on to work for one of the biggest tech companies in the world.** But as I grew in my career, I wasn’t satisfied creating tools for the future while communities like the one I grew up in were being left in the past. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115896493/571829405/-117554302?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_Gilchrist_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODMyYzc4Ny0xYzlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1XR-tBtE0yndjcNS2ek6CF6HXxDBiRjPGR0k7Q5NeVQ=) As a kid from Detroit, I knew how hard families worked just to get by, how systems failed the people who needed them most, and how often talent went unnoticed because of where it came from. I realized the problems I wanted to solve next were bigger than something you could fix with code. So, I left the tech world and ran for public office. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115896495/571829406/-117554302?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_Gilchrist_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODMyYzc4Ny0xYzlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1XR-tBtE0yndjcNS2ek6CF6HXxDBiRjPGR0k7Q5NeVQ=) And let me tell you: that kid _definitely_ never imagined he would become Michigan’s Lieutenant Governor and the highest-ranking Black elected official in state history. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115896497/571829407/-117554302?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_Gilchrist_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODMyYzc4Ny0xYzlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1XR-tBtE0yndjcNS2ek6CF6HXxDBiRjPGR0k7Q5NeVQ=) But there’s still more work to do and the stakes are higher than ever before. **So now, that kid is running for Michigan Governor.** I’m running because I know the difference open doors can make. I’m running because I’ve seen what can happen when government works for the people. I’m running because I believe in a Michigan where everyone has a fair shot. **But Donald Trump and his oligarch administration see it differently.** They’re gutting public education, attacking voting rights, banning books, and putting billionaires over working families at every turn. They want control — not opportunity. Power for the few, not fairness for all. **And after Trump flipped Michigan red last November — this open, blue seat is MAGA’s next target.** **[We need to raise $12,000 every week to build a strong grassroots campaign that can fight against GOP efforts to buy this seat. Please, if you’re with me: will you split a donation between my campaign and Lt. Gov. He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: ** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

subject: Here’s how we flip a governor’s seat in November

body:
On November 4th, Virginia will have the opportunity to flip the governor’s mansion, elect a Democratic lieutenant governor and attorney general, and expand our narrow majority in the General Assembly.
Across the country, Democrats are counting on Virginians to make the first big blow to the MAGA movement. Here’s the game plan Derek - and why we need your help to fund it.
Our elections are coming in less than six weeks, and here’s the thing - Virginia’s elections don’t just impact our state - we’re a bellwether for the rest of the country. What happens here in November is going to help determine our party's chances during the midterms in 2026.
So here’s what we’re going to do - we’re going to defend our majority by supporting Democrats in toss-up districts. We’re also on the offensive by propping up Democrats (many women!) running against vulnerable Republicans.
That means:
🚪 Funding a field program across every corner of our state - that means knocking doors IRL
📱Organizing by phone - we’re text banking, we’re phone banking, we’re talking to people
📬 Direct mail - we’re leaving no stone unturned or mailbox unturned
📺 TV Ads - we’re getting on the air to help make sure our candidates' voices are loud and clear
But all of this costs money, and with only a few weeks left before November, we’re working harder than ever to meet our fundraising goals and ensure that we leave everyone on the playing field.
That’s why we’re asking you to make a split donation between the Democratic Party of Virginia and Tim Kaine. Our on-the-ground efforts of Operation Virginia Victory are underway, but we need grassroots support to continue doing this important work. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-dpva]

The more money we can raise now, the better we can plan for the last few months of this campaign and the more impact we can have. So, let’s do this together and meet our $10,000 grassroots fundraising goal by the end of the day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-dpva]

name: Steve Kerrigan
subject: Support the Election Day Voter Registration Ballot Question
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Dear Peter,
Thank you for joining us at the Democratic State Convention in
Springfield. Together, we showed our commitment to protecting and
strengthening democracy here in Massachusetts. Now it’s time to put
that commitment into action.
With the official endorsement of the Massachusetts State Committee,
we are launching a campaign to bring Election Day Voter Registration to
the Commonwealth- and we need your help.
Together as Democrats, let’s answer Secretary Bill Galvin’s convention
challenge—if 100 local democratic committees collect 1000 signatures
we will reach the 100,000 signature goal. By working together we can
get this done!
To make it as easy as possible for you to get involved, we’ve attached a
printable version of the official petition to this email. Because ballot
question petitions must be signed on paper, not electronically, you can
use this PDF to start collecting signatures right away from registered
voters in your city or town. Please read below for a full message and
detailed instructions on how to properly print, collect and submit
petitions in accordance with Massachusetts election law. Following
these steps carefully is essential to ensure that every signature counts.
Prefer to pick up or get mailed hard copies instead?
We have a limited supply of printed petition sheets available for pick-up at the Massachusetts Democratic Party office. To schedule a time to collect them—or if you’d prefer to have petitions mailed to you—please email us at organizing@massdems.org.
Every signature brings us closer to making Massachusetts a national leader in voter access. Let’s work together to make sure every eligible voter has the freedom to register and vote on Election Day.
Access to Petition in PDF Format [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JpIPxAcZ0isl3EN-zUDcLtPjIE9ErdQy/view]
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Steve%20K%27s%20Signature.png]
Steve Kerrigan
Chair, Massachusetts Democratic Party
The Massachusetts Constitution is very strict about these petitions, so please
follow these instructions to make sure signatures can be counted:
DO:
1) Print the petition on white, letter-sized paper.
2) Print the petition double-sided .
3) Sign your name in the signature column and write your address in the column
next to it.
4) Sign as legibly as possible and make sure the address matches where you’re
registered to vote.
5) Write the name of your city or town in the box at the bottom of the page, and
encourage other voters registered in your community to sign the same sheet as
well.
6) Collect signatures using separate sheets for voters registered in different cities
and towns.
DON’T:
1) Do not alter the petition in any way.
2) Do not scribble, highlight, underline, or make any other marks on the petition.
3) Do not test pens on the petition. No coffee or food stains. NO STRAY
MARKS!
4) Do not write anything on the petition outside of the signature lines or the
boxes for writing the city/town.
5) Do not print the two sides of the petition on two sheets of paper.
6) Do not staple anything to the petition.
7) Do not collect signatures from voters registered in different cities or towns on
the same sheet.
When you’re finished with a sheet for a city or town, please submit it to the
local election official as early as possible . Petitions need to go to the clerk or
election office at the city or town hall where the signatures are gathered. For
example, sheets with signatures from Springfield voters go to the Springfield
Election Commission, while Plymouth signatures go to the Plymouth Town Clerk.
These petitions need to be submitted to local election offices no later than 5 p.m.
on Wednesday, November 19, 2025 , but please deliver or mail your completed
petitions as soon as you complete a sheet for a city or town or at least a week
before this deadline.
If you’re not sure where to submit your petitions, please email us at organizing@massdems.org for help or mail them no later than November 3rd to:
Petition Y
444 Washington St.
Brighton, MA 02135
You can also reach out to info@billgalvin.org .

body:
Two weeks ago, I spoke to the University Democrats at UT Austin. More than 200 students came together to celebrate democracy and talk about the future | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas.com/t-for-transparency-14189318?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=979e13949d&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | , Two weeks ago, I spoke to the University Democrats at UT Austin. It was a great night. More than 200 students came together to celebrate democracy and talk about the future of our country. The UDems are known for their strong voices and hard work knocking on doors, and I was proud to join them. Afterwards, we grabbed pizza at Roppolo’s. As the saying goes, _this is what democracy looks like._ That’s why I was deeply upset to learn that the UT System is now using a new law, SB2972, to forbid the UDems from inviting candidates to speak at their meetings. This is censorship, plain and simple. _It’s a direct attack on students’ First Amendment rights, and it cannot stand._ **Even worse, my opponent in the Democratic primary voted for this terrible bill, joining every Republican in the Senate to pass it. That was a serious failure of judgment, and I’m calling it out.** I’m proud of the students across the UT system who are fighting back in court to protect their First and Fourteenth Amendment rights. **I stand with them, now and always.** As your next Attorney General, I will defend students’ right to free speech, and I will protect Texas universities from the Legislature’s unconstitutional political interference. [**We need someone who has the judgment and the determination to protect Texans and our free speech. I'm here to lead that fight. Will you join me?**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=19c9deb2e4&e=5d8d80652b). Onward!

We're thrilled to share a groundbreaking victory: the United Nations (UN) Human Rights Council adopted a resolution that—for the first time ever—explicitly recognizes sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) as human rights.

This historic step comes after weeks of intense negotiations and represents one of the most significant advancements in UN human rights standards in the last 30 years. **At every stage, the Center worked closely with Member States to secure strong SRHR language in the resolution and to counter anti-rights efforts to weaken human rights commitments, providing technical expertise and mobilizing support at the highest levels.**

Despite efforts by anti-rights actors to dilute the language, all hostile amendments were defeated—a powerful testament to the strength of our global movement and the importance of collaboration between civil society and Member States. This marks not only a significant advancement in global human rights standards, but also a clear political commitment to making these rights a reality for all.

The Center for Reproductive Rights is suing the Trump administration over its failure to respond to multiple Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests seeking transparency around its re-evaluation of abortion pill safety. The lawsuit was filed September 5.

Anti-abortion extremists appear to have played a key role in driving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) decision to re-evaluate mifepristone, a widely used abortion medication. The Center submitted FOIA requests demanding information on political, non-scientific influence in decision-making about mifepristone. Under FOIA, the public has a legal right to this information—and withholding it is against the law.

**Undermining access to mifepristone is part of the Trump administration's larger strategy of under-the-radar attacks on reproductive rights, but the Center is using all legal levers to fight back.**

In July, President Trump signed a sweeping spending bill that includes a provision preventing both Maine Family Planning (MFP) and Planned Parenthood from receiving federal Medicaid reimbursement for family planning and primary care services because they also provide abortion care.

**The Center sued the administration on behalf of MFP, which operates 18 clinics across Maine. Despite the fact that half of MFP's patients rely on Medicaid, a federal court recently refused to stop the cuts to the organization.** We appealed that ruling to the First Circuit Court of Appeals.

In a separate lawsuit, a federal court blocked the defunding of Planned Parenthood, but an appeals court has now suspended that ruling. **This ruling means that MFP will be forced to turn away all of their primary care patients by the end of October, and threatens MFP's ability to continue providing other essential services.**

body:
Public health leaders, Sen. Bernie Sanders, and other concerned Americans are calling for RFK Jr. to resign — myself included. | Folks, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. built his career spreading anti-vaccine conspiracies and anti-science rhetoric. He is wholly unqualified to lead _anything_ in public health, yet Donald Trump handed him the keys to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). Now, public health leaders, Sen. Bernie Sanders, and other concerned Americans are calling for RFK Jr. to resign -- myself included. When MSNBC asked me about it, here's what I said:

**RFK Jr. is like the guy you never wanted to have to partner with in science class.** He thought he knew the answers, and now he's lighting all of HHS on fire -- dismantling the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), threatening to pull vaccines off the shelf, and gutting funding for medical research. Trust in local government comes from accountability. name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: Mail in ballots are out!
body:
Peter, Mail-in ballots have gone out. And I’m urging you not to let that ballot sit unopened. Politics can be tiring. Our choices aren’t always perfect. Trust me – I know this and I feel this.
| | [ ]()
---
Peter, Mail in ballots have gone out. And I’m urging you not to let that ballot sit unopened. Politics can be tiring. Our choices aren’t always perfect. Trust me – I know this and I feel this. But the last few weeks have highlighted that Common Sense New Jerseyans MUST lean in. And that starts with our vote. Charlie Kirk gave his life living out the First Amendment. Voting is a powerful form of speech that translates into policy change, cultural change, and often, generational shifts for good or bad in a state. Elections have consequences. We’ve seen that for bad in the last decade in New Jersey. It’s time to turn things around. We won’t always have that chance. You hopefully tuned into the gubernatorial debate that took place last week. I think it was pretty clear that one candidate wants to continue steering us away from common sense and another is more likely to push us back from the cliff instead of over it. But the outcome depends on _us._ So vote your values. Vote for the family.
Vote for sanity.
Vote for security.
Vote for economic freedom.
Vote for common sense in education.
Vote for safety for our kids. THIS is where we get loud. I will close with these powerful words from Erika Kirk, delivered in Charlie’s moving memorial service to a packed stadium. _The First Amendment of our Constitution is the most human amendment. We are naturally talking beings, naturally believing beings, and the First Amendment protects our right to do both. No assassin will ever stop us from standing up to defend those rights. Ever. Because when you stop the conversation, when you stop the dialogue. This is what happens when we lose the ability and the willingness to communicate. We get violence. _ Our families, our state, and our country can’t afford for us to sit this one out. Are you not on the early voting list? You can still apply before October 28.

[|

| |
South Carolina Senator Margie Bright Matthews joins me to expose how partisan politics at the South Carolina State House endangers citizens, speaking as one of only two women in the South Carolina Senate. She discusses the fight against extreme abortion bans and threats to reproductive rights, plus a healthcare crisis driven by Medicaid cuts, rural hospital closures, and rising maternal mortality rates. Senator Bright Matthews reveals how cultural war issues distract from critical needs in education, infrastructure, and healthcare access in South Carolina. She explains how gerrymandering and Republican primaries create a Democratic super-minority, leaving South Carolina families as political pawns. The conversation covers actionable steps citizens can take to defend reproductive freedom.

Drive-Thru Hours: September 26 & 27: 10:30 am - 8 pm September 28: 11 am to 6 pm Drive-Thru Location: Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Church (30 Huntington Blvd. NE). ~ | STAR CITY STRONGFEST - Sept. 27 Star City StrongFest is a free community festival and strength expo in downtown Roanoke's Elmwood Park, benefiting the Star City Strong Foundation. This unique event serves the community as a celebration of strength sports and community - while recognizing the impact both have on our mental wellness. Check out the Kidz Zone with the fam, shop festival vendors and enjoy some yummy food while watching free amateur and professional Strongman competitions on the stage featuring some of the strongest athletes from around the world this Saturday at Elmwood Park from 9am-6pm. ~~ | AARP SCREENING OF "THE LOST BUS" - Sept. 30 AARP's Movies for Grownups invites you to a free pre-release screening of THE LOST BUS in Roanoke, VA! Tuesday, September 30 at 2 pm at Regal Valley View Grande (4730 Valley View Blvd NW). In support of the Local Office on Aging's Food Pantry, they ask that you bring donations of non-perishible foods to this event for AARP's Hunger Action Month initiative. The movie screening is free, but you must register to attend. Seating is first come, first served so please try and arrive early. AARP membership is not required. ~ | | | INFORMATIONAL MEETING ON DOING BUSINESS WITH RCPS Interested in Doing Business with Roanoke City Public Schools? Join RCPS for an informational session for Local, Small, Women-Owned, and/or Minority-Owned (SWaM) businesses to learn about opportunities to conduct business with Roanoke City Public Schools on October 14, at 10 am at the Community Empowerment Center at Booker T. Washington. Register by Oct 7. | SEPTEMBER IS ATTENDANCE AWARENESS MONTH Missing just two days a month can lead to chronic absenteeism and cause students to fall behind, but together, we can help prevent that! Families play a key role in building strong attendance habits that lead to success: set consistent routines, prep the night before, schedule appointments outside school hours, stay connected with school if your child is sick, talk with your student about how they feel at school. ~ | Community Resources | LEGAL AID SOCIETY OF ROANOKE VALLEY The Legal Aid Society of Roanoke Valley provides a full range of civil legal services to low-income area residents, including issues involving housing, family, employment, consumer debt, and domestic violence. The ACLU has created a collection of resources in the case you or someone you know interacts with ICE agents. Read and share the resources found ~~. ~~ | CONTACT YOUR FEDERAL REPRESENTATIVE In many ways, it feels like our federal government is under attack by the current administration. While our office is happy to assist however we can, it is still crucial that you engage our federal representatives. Find the contact information for the Virginia Congressional Delegation ~~. ~~ | JOIN THE ROANOKE CITY DEMOCRATS! RCDC's monthly business meeting is the third Thursday each month. Watch their Facebook for an upcoming announcement of the agenda. The meetings are available virtually for those who write to mailto:info@roanokedemocrats.com, requesting the link. ~~ | JOIN ROANOKE YOUNG DEMS! clean_body: Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed. Because you’ve been a loyal supporter, I wanted you to hear this directly from me. | Friend, So many kind souls like you have asked how I’m doing, so I wanted to personally update you on my recovery. I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed. Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together. But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in America, I know I can survive ANYTHING! One thing especially helped take the pain away... ...President Trump has announced that he will award me with the Presidential Medal of Freedom – the highest civilian honor in America. President Trump knows I’m in a dire situation right now. His pardon powers only apply to federal cases, which means he legally cannot save me from the bogus state-level charges brought against me by a radical Democrat Attorney General who is trying to imprison me for 20 YEARS. Left with no pardon, no safety net, and no lifeline, my ONLY chance at walking free is to secure a top-notch defense team. But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of BANKRUPTCY. And now, this car crash has set me back even more... And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like YOU. That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I continue fighting for my FREEDOM and my JUSTICE. Because when President Trump places the Medal of Freedom around my neck, I want history to always remember that I FOUGHT for my freedom and justice until the VERY END! Thank you and God bless you, Rudy Giuliani Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust

name: Sen. Jeff Bridges
subject: Treasurer Cary Kennedy has endorsed our campaign
body:
Jeff is someone I trust — not only because he understands the numbers, but because he never forgets what those numbers mean for families.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/85fc2a91a3ff/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10369648?e=b48bb2b4f4)

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Colorado is stronger today because of the leadership of former State Treasurer Cary Kennedy. As Treasurer, she didn’t just manage money—she turned it into opportunity. She created the Building Excellent Schools Today (BEST) program that has funded hundreds of school construction projects across Colorado, especially in rural communities. She also championed Amendment 23, dramatically increasing public school funding statewide.
**That’s why I’m honored to share that Cary Kennedy has endorsed my campaign for Treasurer, so we can invest Colorado dollars back into Colorado families.**
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=825ca914b9&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | “I know what it takes to serve as Colorado’s Treasurer, and I know Jeff Bridges has what it takes. I’ve watched him lead with integrity, humility, and a deep commitment to doing right by people. **Jeff is someone I trust — not only because he understands the numbers, but because he never forgets what those numbers mean for families across Colorado.** That’s why I believe he will be an exceptional Treasurer.” —Cary Kennedy, Former Colorado Treasurer
**First Congressman Joe Neguse. Now former State Treasurer Cary Kennedy.** Colorado’s top leaders are standing with us because they know Colorado’s future depends on investing in our people and communities.
Let’s turn this momentum into a strong end-of-quarter report. Your contribution today makes the difference!

name: Mohan Seshadri
subject: Thank You for Powering Our 5-Year Anniversary Fundraiser!
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Dear Peter,
We’re almost sold out! There are only a few spots left for API PA’s 5-Year Fundraiser – and we want you there.
This year, we’re celebrating a major milestone: five years of organizing, empowering, and building political power for Asian American communities across Pennsylvania. What started with a small group of passionate leaders has become the largest Asian American civic engagement program in the country – reaching communities in 22 languages, uplifting new leaders, and standing strong in the face of adversity.
Together, we’ve fought anti-Asian hate, protected Philadelphia’s Chinatown, and made sure our voices are heard. We’ve achieved so much – but there’s still so much more to do. That’s why we’re inviting you to celebrate this journey with us – and help power the next chapter.
Buy your ticket or donate today [https://secure.everyaction.com/aVBkfzzgLEa9RYppVwVSDQ2?contactdata=EpsWB712gU6vIajR5gfVjgKBPxfpalQ0c/MZEdKpYejFP9nbJ2aWXfnrVTg3gZA/zDuAd8cSkJqy8RZCgMVpgmLUpXFM4/KGkqpvKifht1Q7pJVt0gqsNVtbgAxAgpT3lGEbNZRGK+HU/hIbcikZmwUKXuRo31FdDPqz5O3paX0=]
Join us for an evening of community, delicious food, and powerful stories from the organizers who are leading this work every day. You’ll also get a chance to win exclusive “Treat Yourself” raffle packages , featuring Philly-based experiences and gift cards!
Thank you to all of our in-kind supporters who donated to our raffle: Bubblefish [https://www.bubblefishpa.com/] , Fork [https://forkrestaurant.com/] , Kalaya [https://kalayaphilly.com/] , OX Coffee [https://www.oxcoffee.com/] , Queen & Rook Cafe [https://queenandrookcafe.com/] , and Sabbatical Beauty [https://sabbaticalbeauty.com/?srsltid=AfmBOorbKtdRid10iEb3wmhKkiVYRQEBdz6TECypDLATMvmk2LqWbn2x] !
When: Friday, September 12, 2025 | 6PM-9PM
Where: Bubblefish – 909 Arch Street, Philadelphia, PA 19107
Dress Code: Business/Dressy Casual or Cultural Wear
Your ticket or donation helps ensure we can continue this critical work for the next five years – and beyond. Let’s keep building this movement together.
Thank you for standing with us – and with our Asian American communities. We’re just getting started. And we can’t do it without you.
With gratitude,
Mohan Seshadri
Executive Director
Asian Pacific Islander Political Alliance

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. # Scott Bessent warns NYC what will happen if they elect a socialist: "Drop Dead"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d748ed1a-02ac-4f21-aff6-e0f74dcb1543?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that if socialist Zohran Mamdani becomes NYC mayor and implements his socialist economic plans, the city will inevitably need a federal bailout, which Bessent vowed to deny, referencing Gerald Ford's famous "drop dead" response to New York's 1970s financial crisis.
"I guarantee you, and there're not a lot of things in life that are sure, but New York City will be coming to the federal government for a bailout if Mamdani's plans are implemented," Bessent told FOX Business' Maria Bartiromo. "It will be the same thing that Gerald Ford said. Drop dead."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9b8a9eed-ade3-4f94-a559-c049de3a6fcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Economic exodus prediction** : Bessent cautioned that Mamdani's policies would drive away high earners and businesses from New York, noting that the past five years have already seen "the greatest transfer of wealth in U.S. history from Manhattan County to Palm Beach County."
* **Controversial socialist agenda** : The 33-year-old democratic socialist's campaign platform includes proposals that have alarmed Wall Street executives, such as free buses, city-owned grocery stores, and rent freezes for rent-stabilized tenants, all centered around affordability themes.
* **Wall Street opposition** : Following Mamdani's surprise Democratic primary victory, billionaire hedge fund manager Bill Ackman pledged to finance a rival candidate and warned that the socialist agenda would "destroy jobs and cause businesses and wealthy taxpayers" to flee, declaring "Socialism has no place in the economic capital of our country."

# Starbucks announces closures and job cuts amid turnaround plan
Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol **[announced Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/9495c48a-19d5-417f-b9c3-2f07623fa4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that the company will close underperforming U.S. stores, eliminate 900 non-retail positions, and freeze hiring as part of its turnaround strategy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9495c48a-19d5-417f-b9c3-2f07623fa4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"These steps are to reinforce what we see is working and prioritize our resources against them," Niccol said.
* **The closures will target locations unable to meet customer and employee expectations** or achieve financial performance goals. Affected store employees will be notified this week, while corporate staff facing job cuts will learn Friday. Niccol, a year into his role, said the company is "ahead of schedule" in its turnaround but acknowledged significant work remains.
* **A good start:** Despite the cuts, early results show improved customer engagement at upgraded locations, with visitors staying longer and providing positive feedback.

# **The right direction: Unemployment claims beat expectations**
Initial jobless claims for the week ending September 20 **[fell to 218,000, down 14,000 from the previous week](https://substack.com/redirect/9286e219-45c8-4676-894b-09104605752b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and well below the expected 235,000, suggesting the labor market remains more resilient than feared despite Federal Reserve concerns about employment risks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9286e219-45c8-4676-894b-09104605752b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strong economic data across multiple sectors** : GDP growth was revised upward to 3.8% for Q2 (from earlier estimates), consumer spending increased 2.5%, and durable goods orders rose 2.9% in August, all indicating underlying economic strength despite earlier recession concerns.
* **Federal Reserve policy implications** : The positive data comes just after the Fed cut rates by 0.25% to 4%-4.25% in September, citing employment concerns, though Chair Jerome Powell noted the economy is showing "resilience" amid various policy changes while keeping the door open for additional cuts.
* **Market expectations remain unchanged** : Despite the encouraging economic indicators, markets still anticipate two more Fed rate cuts this year at the October and December meetings, as policymakers continue monitoring data for signs of where to take monetary policy next.

# **White House tells federal agencies to prepare for mass firings if gov 't shuts down**
The White House Office of Management and Budget directed federal agencies to prepare plans for **[permanently eliminating jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/26d1fa3c-cd56-455e-a9ec-e19649da233d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during a potential government shutdown, departing from typical protocols where furloughed workers are eventually brought back with back pay, Bloomberg reports.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/26d1fa3c-cd56-455e-a9ec-e19649da233d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Targeting unnecessary programs** : Agencies must identify programs where discretionary funding lapses on October 1st with no alternative funding sources, then draft plans to permanently cut jobs in areas deemed unessential and "not consistent with the President's priorities" if Congress fails to continue funding.
* **Lapse of protocol** : The move is a lapse of normal shutdown procedures and has ruffled feathers in congress, with Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer calling it "an attempt at intimidation" and predicting court challenges or eventual rehiring.
* **Funding impasse context** : The directive comes amid congressional deadlock over government funding.

Now that Rosh Hashanah has come to an end, I can tell you that I have been thinking a lot about my parents and grandparents who are no longer with us.
I’ve thought about the lessons they instilled in me over the years. The lessons that my family and faith taught me about our obligation to mend that which needs fixing in the world, even when so much around us seems broken. Those ideas continue to guide me to this day.
These principles have led me to try and make sure we help feed those who are hungry, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, to ensure the rule of law is applied equally, and to protect our democracy — a precious miracle that has never been in greater jeopardy.
It is because of my family and faith that I have not been discouraged when Trump and his cult of MAGA allies hurl attacks my way. I know that even in the face of these MAGA attempts to retaliate against my efforts to hold the president accountable — from investigating and impeaching Donald Trump to managing his Senate trial to serving on the January 6 Committee — we can overcome their attacks, strengthen our democracy, and make the progress our country demands.

Fellow Conservative,

When our voters stay at home, we lose critically essential races.

All year, my colleagues in the Senate and I have been raising the alarm bells about what would happen if our supporters stayed home during pivotal races.

_**A couple of weeks ago, we found out.**_****

I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed. Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together. But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in America, I know I can survive ANYTHING! One thing especially helped take the pain away... ...President Trump has announced that he will award me with the Presidential Medal of Freedom – the highest civilian honor in America. President Trump knows I’m in a dire situation right now. His pardon powers only apply to federal cases, which means he legally cannot save me from the bogus state-level charges brought against me by a radical Democrat Attorney General who is trying to imprison me for 20 YEARS. Left with no pardon, no safety net, and no lifeline, my ONLY chance at walking free is to secure a top-notch defense team. But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of BANKRUPTCY. And now, this car crash has set me back even more...** And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like YOU. That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I continue fighting for my FREEDOM and my JUSTICE. ICYMI, over the summer, Pete Hegseth quietly (or not so quietly) made it crystal clear what he thinks of women. Like, all of us. Here’s a headline that sums it up:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Nothing to see here! Just the Secretary of Defense casually supporting the disenfranchisement of more than half the U.S. population!
Serious question: Is Pete Hegseth *trying* to disqualify himself from his job even more than he already has??
I know some of the reaction to this headline and these posts from Hegseth are going to be along the lines of: Relax. It’s not a big deal — he doesn’t actually mean that!
To that I say: Just like the GOP didn’t actually mean Roe should be overturned...?
I’m not interested in being told to calm down when a senior member of the United States government is echoing and praising an extreme anti-woman voice — and one that is explicitly calling for the end of women’s right to vote.
That’s not all Hegseth’s favorite pastor has said, by the way. He also said God created women “to make the sandwiches” and that homosexuality should be criminalized, among many other disgusting, offensive views.
This kind of bigoted extremism has in recent years been considered “fringe” — but news flash: when the U.S. Secretary of Defense is platforming and re-posting this stuff, it can no longer be thought of as outside the realm of possibility!
I’m writing to you about this not just to vent — although we all need to do some of that these days. I’m reaching out because this kind of rhetoric from those leading our country HAS to be met with a real response from those of us who see how horrific it is.
We don’t want to legitimize it, but we also can’t just shrug and say, “well, that was crazy!” and move on with our days.
My suggestion: We should respond by winning elections.
We should roll up our sleeves, capture every little bit of anger and outrage, and channel it into flipping the House next year and chipping away at the extreme GOP’s triple majority in Washington.
That’s how we make a real statement.
I’m all in on this — my team and I are laser-focused on retaking a Democratic majority, working to support Democratic challengers and incumbents, and of course winning my own re-election. If you’re in, too, will you chip in today to support our work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

The One Big Beautiful Bill law hurts working families in our communities and all across the country.

They called it “beautiful.” But there is nothing beautiful about slashing Medicaid and gutting nutrition programs, or rising energy costs for families.

These programs are lifelines. SNAP helps working families put food on the table. Medicaid keeps caregivers working and patients safe. Energy tax credits lower utility bills. Every one of these cuts makes it harder for working families to make ends meet.

And for what? To hand out billions in tax breaks to billionaires. Working families are paying the price so the well-connected can pad their bottom line.

The Chiltons understand that NV-04 needs a Congressman who will unapologetically defend our southern border and Americans against the cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals who cross our border illegally. Here is what they had to say when they endorsed me:

Meanwhile, Democrats like Steve Horsford keep ignoring it. America needs leaders who understand the stakes and have the courage to act. David Flippo is one of them. As a combat veteran and strong conservative, he will fight to finish the wall, support the Border Patrol, and stand with President Trump to shut down the chaos at our southern border. American ranchers like us are on the front lines. We need a warrior in Congress, and David Flippo has our full support and endorsement.”

name: Travis Grantham
subject: Reverse the sharp decline in the number of Veterans in Congress -- and turn Washington, DC around!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GRANTHAM FOR CONGRESS]()
body:
I did something most members of Congress never do – I served my country in combat!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3c5e8ce2daf7/welcome-to-team-grantham-10141124?e=0b767f7f9d)
---
[|
---](https://mcshanellc.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a964730c3815d48603a3e5f85&id=6064323d56&e=0b767f7f9d)
| | | | | | Friend,
As a veteran, I’m shocked how few veterans are in Congress compared to just a few decades ago. After WWII, many veterans ran for public office because they wanted to continue to serve their country, and they were equipped with a unique skillset, allowing them to lead our federal government. Today, the percentage of members of Congress who have served our nation in uniform is down dramatically from around 80% to close to 20%.
As a combat veteran who continues to serve in the United States Air Force Reserve, I was proud to serve my nation in combat and defend our nation’s freedoms. That is why it is so hard to watch as leftist members of Congress push their anti-American policies on the rest of us. Democrats used to believe in the values of the Constitution and traditionally liberal principles like freedom of speech. Now they push laws that restrict free speech, the Second Amendment, and much of the rest of the Constitution. I say “No More!”
We need more patriots in Congress, and you deserve to have the people you elect represent you in Congress with love for our country and the founding principles they are sworn to protect. A nation cannot long survive if half of the people making its laws are intent on tearing it down.
And as I did in the Arizona Legislature, I also want to use my military experience to be an effective champion for our nation’s veterans and their families. They deal with a unique set of challenges and they deserve the respect and support of the country they served.
---
[|
---](https://mcshanellc.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a964730c3815d48603a3e5f85&id=ace32a92c9&e=0b767f7f9d)

| | Team, Colorado’s 4th Congressional District has long been a Republican stronghold. That's why Lauren Boebert saw opportunity to abandon her old district which she only won by 546 votes and carpetbag to Eastern Colorado. Extremists are counting on this seat staying red. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115921458/571890314/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDU2MDYxOC0zNjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kY2s72hDCLgoohCTaKTceywwjdCY2QAeks3LIV9qOHY=&emci=83646eec-1294-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=e0560618-369a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239)

| | Congress is back in session this month, and I have been traveling back and forth between Northwest Washington and D.C. Here at home, I have been hearing your concerns about the Trump administration, their policy, and budget cuts. **This month, I sat with Anacortes school leaders to talk about federal funding.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115921459/571890315/1593197556?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDU2MDYxOC0zNjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kY2s72hDCLgoohCTaKTceywwjdCY2QAeks3LIV9qOHY=&emci=83646eec-1294-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=e0560618-369a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239)**[Read More](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115921460/571890316/1593197556?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDU2MDYxOC0zNjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kY2s72hDCLgoohCTaKTceywwjdCY2QAeks3LIV9qOHY=&emci=83646eec-1294-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=e0560618-369a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239) I have been meeting with school district leaders around Northwest Washington to better understand how federal funding plays into their budgets. In July, Trump froze billions of dollars in education funding that had already been appropriated by Congress. $137 million was designated for Washington schools, with about $100,000 specifically for Anacortes. **Ultimately, at the end of July, after bipartisan pressure, the funding was released.** The Anacortes district administrators shared with me that any further cuts to federal education funding would put programs for Anacortes students and teachers at risk. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115921461/571890317/-972090100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDU2MDYxOC0zNjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kY2s72hDCLgoohCTaKTceywwjdCY2QAeks3LIV9qOHY=&emci=83646eec-1294-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=e0560618-369a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239) [Read More](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115921462/571890318/-972090100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDU2MDYxOC0zNjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kY2s72hDCLgoohCTaKTceywwjdCY2QAeks3LIV9qOHY=&emci=83646eec-1294-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=e0560618-369a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239) **Outdoor Alliance Washington (OA Washington) released their trip report from our hike on the Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest.** We looked at the forest and the trails and discussed the impact of the Trump administration on public lands. The Trump administration has cut staff at the U.S. Forest Service and National Park Service and is rescinding the U.S. Forest Service's Roadless Rule, which protects nearly 59 million acres of national forest. The U.S. Forest Service Roadless Rule prevents and restricts new road construction, timber harvesting, and mineral leasing in designated "roadless areas." **We still have a lot of work to do to protect our public lands**. We must protect the Roadless Rule and our environment because a healthy environment is vital to Washingtonians' way of life and the regional economy. subject: A $50,000 BRIBE with no consequences
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
FIRST: Trump’s border czar, Tom Homan, was recorded in September 2024 accepting a $50,000 bribe from undercover FBI agents after indicating he could provide them with government contracts in a second Trump administration, according to an MSNBC report [https://www.msnbc.com/msnbc/news/tom-homan-cash-contracts-trump-doj-investigation-rcna232568].
THEN: Trump’s DOJ closed the FBI’s case against Homan, calling it a politically motivated “deep state” probe.
NOW: House and Senate Democrats are opening investigations [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/09/23/us/politics/tom-homan-democrats-investigation.html] into the Trump administration's decision to close the case, demanding that Attorney General Pam Bondi and FBI Director Kash Patel turn over all materials related to the case.
https://x.com/bresreports/status/1969518736005874106?s=46 [https://x.com/bresreports/status/1969518736005874106?s=46]
This is the kind of corruption that has eroded public trust in government. Americans want real change in Washington, and to make that happen, we need to strike at the root of dysfunction–Big Money and corporate lobbying.
I’ve introduced a resolution with a bold, comprehensive anti-corruption plan to ensure elected officials put people and country first by:
✅ Banning all PAC and lobbyist money from Congress
✅ Banning members of Congress and their families from trading stocks
✅ Enacting 12-year term limits for members of Congress and 18-year term limits for Supreme Court Justices
✅ Instituting a binding code of ethics for Supreme Court justices
Sign if you agree: It’s time to reform Washington. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/political-reform-platform-petition?contactdata=pqofZA+EXFEmXpql63OZu6loU8glq8yoZIN/r16ZtbXP/FPv11lyuFls+XxYgTcawVNTSoBdDNnBUYvWpXLyrE0LUYdSO6tLMB0LJJI0IvPVQef2vIQrcOGQj4EC/ZkBmbLoWw8rr1L7m6CiMO3FVIqEZtxZIS9DNuWd3JBJ11C2jRrxQLtFo/9QJ1U+kFRh]

I’m confident that Democrats can take back Congress in 2026 by running on this plan. More than that, I firmly believe that by addressing corruption on Capitol Hill, we can create a stronger democracy that works for the American people, not just the rich and powerful.
Thank you for your activism and all that you do.
In solidarity,
Ro
Wait! One more thing–
Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Guardian: Trump’s justice department appointees remove leadership of voting unit [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092525_1&amount=25]
This speaks for itself, folks. Straight from The Guardian :
" Donald Trump’s appointees at the Department of Justice have removed all of the senior civil servants working as managers in the department’s voting section and directed attorneys to dismiss all active cases, according to people familiar with the matter, part of a broader attack on the department’s civil rights division. "
This action represents a dramatic escalation in Trump's war on voting, coming after he ordered a permanent litigation freeze on voting cases back in January and then issued his suppressive, anti-voting executive order last month.
It's worth noting that the staff removed are nonpartisan civil servants -- lawyers who are career DOJ employees and serve regardless of who is president. Any partisan presidential appointees from the Biden administration ended their jobs when Trump was inaugurated and have been gone for months.
Are we surprised? No. But this action -- though expected, based on how this division was sidelined in Trump's first four years -- highlights how badly we need to fight for our fundamental rights as citizens , from the outside of government.
Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can today to help us defend the right to vote across the country, from state legislatures to courtrooms to the ballot box? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092525_1&amount=25]

The civil rights division, which was created in 1957 and is often referred to as the “crown jewel” of the justice department, has always been a cornerstone in the fight to protect our right to vote.
But when Trump campaign lawyer and election denier Harmeet Dhillon -- who has argued in court in favor of voter suppression laws -- was confirmed to lead the department last month, she sent out new “mission statements” that made it clear the civil rights division was shifting its focus from protecting the civil rights of marginalized people to supporting Trump’s priorities.
You don't have to read into that to get the message: Our fundamental rights, including voting and so much more, aren't going to be protected by this administration. In fact, they're going to be repeatedly attacked from within our government until they ensconce their control forever.

Most of you have probably seen by now that Donald Trump has finally gotten the Justice Department to move forward with bullshit prosecutions against James Comey and Letitia James. He fired the sitting U.S. attorney--someone who didn't think charges would stick or even make it to a jury--and replaced them with one of his former defense attorneys. And here's the part that's really lodged in my brain since I found out last night: the person he picked has never prosecuted a case in her life.
**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/ca1a80ff-1abd-4664-be6a-f31aae52d48b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Just sit with that for a second. Forget the politics. Forget the revenge tour. Let's just talk about what's necessary to keep Americans safe. Because instead of picking someone remotely qualified to do one of the most serious jobs in government, he picked another loyalist to carry out his personal vendettas.
Meanwhile, real criminals are out there--drug traffickers, sex offenders, murderers, white-collar predators targeting middle-class families and retirees. These people need to be caught, charged, and put away. That takes professionals. Adults in the room. People who know how the system works and can wield it with precision. But instead, Trump has corrupted the entire process by installing unqualified hacks in roles that actually matter.
Kash Patel and Dan Bongino are perfect examples. Patel's been an embarrassment these past few weeks--inserting himself into active federal cases, screwing them up, and chasing headlines instead of criminals.
What Trump has done to the DOJ, the FBI, and every other federal agency in just nine short months of assuming office has weakened our country on every front. He's replacing qualified public servants with sycophants. Do you feel safer flying now that Sean Duffy--a former reality TV contestant--is running the Transportation Department? Do you feel confident and reassured knowing Pete Hegseth, a Fox News host who had to promise to stop drinking just to be considered for Defense Secretary, is making life-and-death decisions? I sure as hell don't.

If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/ca1a80ff-1abd-4664-be6a-f31aae52d48b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

And it's happening everywhere. RFK Jr. is in charge of Health and Human Services and telling people that Tylenol causes autism--something that has not been proven on any level. So again, I ask: do you feel safer? Healthier? Stronger as a country? Is this what you voted for? Is it what anybody voted for?
It's not what I voted for. And it's not what a lot of lifelong Republicans I know--including my own dad, a three-time Trump voter--voted for either. What we've got now is a full-on carnival show with real consequences that have jeopardized the sanctity of our democratic institutions.
We can have real, honest debates in this country about the problems we face and how to solve them. That's democracy. Left, right, center--whatever. But we're not even having those debates, because the most unqualified people in America are now in charge, racing to the bottom. And now Trump's former defense attorney--someone who has never tried a case--is running the U.S. Attorney's Office in Virginia. That's not a functioning justice system. That's a damn joke.
Yes, cronyism has always been part of politics. But some roles are supposed to rise above it--Attorney General, FBI Director, U.S. Attorneys. These are supposed to be the adults: professional, qualified, level-headed, focused, honorable. The people who don't answer to party politics, but to the law. Because bad shit will happen. And when it does, we need professionals at the helm. Not conspiracy-theory pushers like Patel's FBI, which responded to the Kirk shooting by throwing gasoline on the fire and birthing more conspiracies than I've seen since the Kennedy assassination.
When you abuse federal power like this, criminals walk free and regular people get hurt. That's the bottom line. We now have a government of grievance. A government of one man--Donald Trump--hellbent on revenge, surrounded by yes-men who will never tell him the truth, who care more about titles and paychecks than national security.
It's more dangerous to be an American citizen today because of it. We're sitting on a ticking time bomb--we know some foreign or domestic actor is ready to exploit this chaos, if not already. Maybe it's fraud rings going after seniors. Maybe it's a cyberattack from Russia. Maybe it's a terrorist group plotting payback. You don't think Iran's watching, waiting for the next opening after we bombed them a few months ago?
Bad things happen in free societies. I get that. But we used to have highly qualified public servants--like my father, who spent 34 years in the FBI--doing their jobs quietly, professionally, and without playing politics. Now? At every level? That professionalism is gone. And we, the People, are paying the price--not only with our tax dollars but with our personal safety.
And as trust in our institutions collapses, so does our ability to function as a free society. This is one of the most dangerous periods in American history--and we're sleepwalking through it while the clowns run the show.

Dear Friend, I was planning to write and tell you all about our incredible August 16th **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** **DAY** event at the Library of Congress to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”But then the reports started coming in from parents and grandparents across the country about the opposition they faced at their **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** events. Friend, I know the mainstream media won’t spend a second telling you what happened so I will.In Cuyahoga, OH, protestors formed an intimidating gauntlet at the entrance to the public library. Parents had to shepherd their children through it as if they were criminals just to get into our event. Then inside, while BRAVE families were hearing books about Godly virtues, protestors held up their own inappropriate books showing pornographic content, including one depicting sexual acts between two men.In Highlands Ranch, CO, a group of grandparents invited a local deputy to read the BRAVE book, _The Test of Lionhood_ which teaches children the importance of courage, perseverance and masculinity. When the unhinged atheists at the _Freedom from Religion Foundation_ got wind of the grandparents’ effort to share these virtues with Colorado children, they fired off a threatening letter to the Sheriff’s Department.

Fellow Conservative,

They’re calling us **_“backward,” “extreme,”_** and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right.

They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you.

I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment.

I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. _**While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.**_****

I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks and enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, weeks after 9/11. Service has always been my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. This is a different kind of fight, but the stakes are just as high.

Minnesota hasn’t backed a Republican for president since 1976, and this Senate race is an uphill climb. I’m the underdog — a regular Minnesotan called to an extraordinary challenge. **[With your support, we can turn this seat red and send a message to Washington](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=57c32efd7ee446b4a6fa0c47119c1955&_e=mUVfHx_CrHwxFOLMnPgEE9CjUfp7U4LxjTCX6RHrlbGfNyJKCvc56oVLlZqRB2guk1LOd_hq7G0Sk2lUGkMPYJ9xhF_jgofzSwk0r4xY--8P8dXVLpIRSM3Q2kuA07_22B-nqFDB5Cw4kkofwWIRzJQlK9rBHbP6ROIYF4meqpEzHaSzq3GTZAldki8JgLnwid4UXNJjiP7DQb7e1jO7M_eyZbYv6L-DP0_lRpLSPlj5AEwUwDf7VHlAnPGJFqp2-MSAdkJ1-HH81butL0KPSaNJLDBDCEw3oe_U7oH0KkzrBThmKblSChmQZVI_RtmSbnnvZ12Yg42RewB8p1FFWFtLONx0wTPj3i99tFU90CkgfQDoCrPe6uFRdKaPDTKmW8GKhhx4TVx1wiPITNSIsrPTKIKfc7s0_pYdGfOlzwt9JiQx8ToWQWbSDCTXkmv_CSn9FFXywrzRTjgqaaRp-_IhZPafNdN_OUZXjzUrCFxUVTZ5fTM5Krf5NHTa2NTXiAoSi7X4-Mj7XohNx4KjnT89f87_VtSPwfI4bTKRxvj30ZsHLRhdISwwbZRQ7lsQBl-N5eB5NddRfBF6DHhVdDrfSwFFmWj_uI86VnPY0DH81Ra9ybP2XnRnU1dU29x4p_1AgxVWLs-lWom7u50vxQ40hbseo4f_RNpNmSoUfQJxwWSTyWQdmCq_BvplLwZRPdF9ePUDTclLGiDTPvG4BJ6R14cgoDLlkmzk7p2ZL-YYzc26vtiFKKhCLClQ8G3vTeCR3dhCtMXN6enEi0aZleJxRTCtWOsfzp61wXi8sYY%3D)**.

clean_body: Tim Walz and the radical left are preparing for war - it’s up to us to stop them. As a former Navy SEAL, I believe I can be of assistance. | Fellow Conservative, They’re calling us “backward,” “extreme,” and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right. They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment. I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.** I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks and enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, weeks after 9/11. Service has always been my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. This is a different kind of fight, but the stakes are just as high. Minnesota hasn’t backed a Republican for president since 1976, and this Senate race is an uphill climb. I’m the underdog — a regular Minnesotan called to an extraordinary challenge. . You have a choice. You can set this email aside, or you can join me in sending a second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate — someone forged in service, ready for the challenge, and driven by principle, not pride. I’ve earned degrees from Harvard and Johns Hopkins and trained in high-stakes fields like nuclear deterrence. I’ve built coalitions across cultures and led through crises. But the greatest challenge is earning your trust and building a movement to reclaim our state. I’m not asking for a free pass — I’m asking for your partnership. Our country is worth defending.
