And that's a good lesson for all of us. When the challenge is hard, things often don't go according to plan. Then you have to take a break, refigure your plan, recharge, and get back out there. And that's what I'm doing. = This week, I watched Donald Trump address the United Nations. His message? America is doing great under his leadership, and the rest of the world should follow his path. In reality, we've had eight months of policies that have made Americans sicker and poorer: higher food prices, skyrocketing health care costs, and millions at risk of losing their health insurance thanks to Republicans' Big, Ugly Betrayal of a bill. Trump's denial of climate chaos was just as shameful. The world is already suffering immensely from climate chaos — fires are burning a record number of acres, stronger storms are wiping away homes, and droughts are stressing farms and ecosystems across the planet — but Trump stood on the global stage denying this reality. We cannot allow Trump to continue unchecked. We must put America back on track with a government of, by, and for the people — not billionaires, not MAGA extremists. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/25/2025
body:
From pulpits to school boards and special districts: A call for Christians to step up
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎙️ Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Outrage is mounting in Douglas County after a judge gave [probation to a repeat violent offender](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), fueling demands for tougher sentencing. At the same time, Colorado’s [sports betting program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has generated over $65 million for water projects since 2020. [Housing prices show slight relief](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) but remain out of reach for most families, while Denver’s 2026 budget [protects public safety](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) but delays new facilities and cadet hiring. And nearly four years after the Marshall Fire, Xcel agreed to a [$640 million settlement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with victims, though it still denies responsibility.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Google admitted [censoring Americans under Biden administration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) pressure but now pledges to restore banned YouTube accounts, including conservative voices. Meanwhile, President Trump [blasted the UN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a fiery speech, denouncing “globalism” and warning that European recognition of a Palestinian state only rewards Hamas and prolongs conflict.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** This week’s commentary covers immigration, education, and the American spirit. Writers support Trump's EO for a [“Gold Card” residency](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to reward those who invest in America, criticize the governor’s mansion being used to push an [animal-rights agenda](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and urge conservatives to [“prove Charlie right”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by defending freedom and responsibility. Critics also argue schools [betray the growth mindset](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by rewarding excuses, while Douglas County residents call on Christians to [step up in civic life](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—from pulpits to school boards—to restore culture and community.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, September 25, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[From pulpits to school boards and special districts: A call for Christians to step up](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CHUCK O'REILLY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Every decision about schools, taxes and local government touches the lives of families in the pews each week. When Christians disengage from civic life, we leave those decisions to others—and the results are visible in our classrooms, neighborhoods and property tax bills._
_I’m writing to encourage Christians that their values matter at the ballot box. When it comes time to vote, Christian values are needed at the polling place. Pastors and priests should urge their congregations to step forward as candidates in local elections, and groups like the Non Partisan Elections Committee stand ready to support those efforts._
_For years, charity in America was mainly carried out by churches. **[Douglas County outrage grows after judge hands out probation in violent crime case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Douglas County judge is under fire after sentencing 31-year-old Taylor Burrows, convicted of stalking and assaulting his ex-fiancé, to probation instead of prison, sparking outrage from the victim and prosecutors.
* District Attorney George Brauchler criticized the ruling as risky for public safety, noting probation officers classified Burrows as a “maximum risk to re-offend,” and neighboring counties had rejected him from community corrections.
* Victim Aubrey Cadwell said she feels unsafe knowing Burrows is free, calling the decision a failure to protect her and questioning if the system is waiting for him to re-offend before acting.

While the Trump administration wages a relentless campaign against Planned Parenthood and an all-out assault on reproductive health care, California is fighting back.
This week I led a multistate coalition in filing a motion for a preliminary injunction to block the administration from defunding Planned Parenthood and enacting what amounts to a back-door abortion ban.
Please sign my petition today if you agree we can’t allow these back-door bans to go into effect. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/PUi6URSd2ESjgBVMH2Xiyw2]
Here’s what’s going on:
The GOP’s so-called “big, beautiful” bill, signed into law this summer, contained a “Defund Provision” that blocks certain health centers — including Planned Parenthood — from receiving federal Medicaid funding.
Let’s be clear: this funding was *never* used to provide abortion care. Instead, it allows Planned Parenthood to provide cancer screenings, STI testing and treatment, and birth control to low-income patients.
But thanks to Trump’s reckless and cruel budget provisions, this loss of funding puts these health centers at risk of closure, leaving vulnerable patients in the lurch.
My support for Planned Parenthood and the many other health centers providing essential care is resolute — and the stakes have never been higher.
Will you add your name today to stand with me in the fight to protect Planned Parenthood and reproductive health care? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/PUi6URSd2ESjgBVMH2Xiyw2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/PUi6URSd2ESjgBVMH2Xiyw2]
Millions of low-income patients across California and the country rely on these health centers for the care they need, so we can’t back down in our fight to keep them safe.
Thanks for speaking out.
—Rob

body:
How many preventable child deaths are an acceptable sacrifice?
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115928503/571913131/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjNhOWQwNS00NjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WH2Sz5_zfPhN7wFF7-DqSVx_cya5J2C4H9FPL_Tuhdo=&emci=1819ecc5-2e9a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&emdi=123a9d05-469a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9818364)
---

| | In recent weeks, Oregonians have been writing and calling my office to tell me they're unable to get the latest COVID-19 vaccine. **This is a direct result of HHS Secretary RFK Jr.'s unending crusade against accurate information and health safety.** Instead of finding ways to help families better afford their medical bills and access the best possible care and medicine, he is singularly focused on his anti-vaccine mission, despite promises during his confirmation that he wouldn't stand in the way of vaccines. **So here's my question for RFK Jr.: how many preventable child deaths are an acceptable sacrifice?** His conspiracy theory-fueled actions have real consequences for my constituents. I'm not going to stop fighting to hold him accountable. body:
Andrew Cuomo’s camp has a new strategy to defeat Zohran Mamdani | | | Peter, Andrew Cuomo’s camp has a new strategy to defeat Zohran Mamdani: **"You have to frighten people to give them a reason to go to the polls."** That’s what an unnamed adviser close to the disgraced former Governor told _New York Magazine_ last week.1 Another top Cuomo donor said that "if Eric (Adams) gets out, there is going to be a gush of money coming Andrew’s way, $20 million to $30 million in a matter of weeks." **They’re finally saying the quiet part out loud, Peter.** Their strategy isn’t about policies that will make New York City more safe and more affordable. It’s not about listening to and caring for the millions of struggling working families who call this city home. **It’s about courting support from pro-Trump billionaires, sowing fear, and spreading lies.** The attacks against Zohran have already begun. And with just 40 days until the election, we need to brace for them to ramp up even more — just like they’re promising. [Please make a donation today and help WFP continue to mobilize volunteers, talk to voters in New York, and elect Zohran Mamdani as the city’s next Mayor. With early voting starting in just a few weeks, we need to prepare for the onslaught of attacks coming our way.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T966anOFnxLCk2AXJI73uxGSLmRMdGv-c4Uylq146WrIuQo10om7C74A2mHyADw7dfQ2HoIF_A-cehQkotfcTIYsGkl7iq4H3Ajh3MYDHFBiKOzvckskhPklfw5gXYR6PCUdztCQPWF6ER3uIrNyDYQILdkZ_FCRdWSnWKAL7jY7hM8g6HYN2H_wvHgA-BAoUKI7z2iJX1taPcMj5_CtQK1CPh8qKfyQtKhD8Yhfe_a2X6_ksk_y3VGe-gZ_9nMiTpPW0Gjx1IsRWB2iuIZsqDjR3yFx41Fttl_S3LkqAXSsaQ2pt8ksPzuREa-FNpgt-8vA8BFNzUWodqGR9ANNtlMdtBMMJ9W2cJBaI-br6Oa3Idtl3JxtkoXXYTtM-2ymz5ISMTQhDK6TzPMg4UmC2sEA/4k7/xzsWXTEgQRiCNzdLHSBVQw/h0/h001.yqWyqkIj_oNxqjzVIgmJuEnAO16Q0wEKKBgCtdVhpgs) **[Donate »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T966anOFnxLCk2AXJI73uxGSLmRMdGv-c4Uylq146WrItv1VDVNZdh0sjyW8axUE_UQPjiLt3d6mdHJNaKrjYHdOmBTVyliK8Wnpx4mlo3w-WvM6PhT6quwhZAWeAKZ0NBMXYukPJh65FQdpZs3_TclFLsq-sdPdc7ST5ppJhbH3AkwnUEcxllXREYqnADHR1WyZlQ9yjrAgSiNm6ihJ4i0wTN6UcxJfDPngKJErS2Quo7S0Jaz2Xe_1K36ao2esfR9xqJcOT4Bd675uGOz8BCCAMkUoLNmLDXKJ1C1IwB1P5vfBA02VP42eny5CfKHw_l4kcyV9AaHT5ojmfYrJnbPpY8G09FnchL10g_UByNvUe-1VebAqvADrlFo60jK3M3iB4X9eLKqz1DojSFq3RXjA/4k7/xzsWXTEgQRiCNzdLHSBVQw/h1/h001.xVH9b_5SfLWFVZq-OfoKQRADbfjhTA2Kl7LH6cmQ0pY)** If these fear-based and manipulative tactics sound like something Donald Trump would employ, that’s no accident. Like that other famous "Queens boy," Andrew Cuomo built his entire political career through threats and bullying. In fact, just a few years ago, Cuomo was telling advisors and aides that he wanted to "destroy" the Working Families Party.2 Why? Because we’ve worked to hold elected officials like him accountable for policies that hurt working class New Yorkers. Because we’ve spent over two decades trying to push Democrats and Republicans alike — both in New York and across the nation — to embrace a political vision that puts working people over billionaires. Because we believe power ultimately rests with the people — not the billionaire donor class. **Stoking fear and threatening political opponents? Sounds an awful lot like how the current administration operates. And that’s not the kind of leadership New York City needs — not now, not ever.** [Join our efforts to elect Zohran Mamdani as Mayor of New York City by pitching in today. clean_body: Andrew Cuomo’s camp has a new strategy to defeat Zohran Mamdani | | | Peter, Andrew Cuomo’s camp has a new strategy to defeat Zohran Mamdani: "You have to frighten people to give them a reason to go to the polls." That’s what an unnamed adviser close to the disgraced former Governor told New York Magazine last week.1 Another top Cuomo donor said that "if Eric (Adams) gets out, there is going to be a gush of money coming Andrew’s way, $20 million to $30 million in a matter of weeks." They’re finally saying the quiet part out loud, Peter. Their strategy isn’t about policies that will make New York City more safe and more affordable. It’s not about listening to and caring for the millions of struggling working families who call this city home. It’s about courting support from pro-Trump billionaires, sowing fear, and spreading lies. The attacks against Zohran have already begun. And with just 40 days until the election, we need to brace for them to ramp up even more — just like they’re promising. If these fear-based and manipulative tactics sound like something Donald Trump would employ, that’s no accident. Like that other famous "Queens boy," Andrew Cuomo built his entire political career through threats and bullying. In fact, just a few years ago, Cuomo was telling advisors and aides that he wanted to "destroy" the Working Families Party.2 Why? Because we’ve worked to hold elected officials like him accountable for policies that hurt working class New Yorkers. Because we’ve spent over two decades trying to push Democrats and Republicans alike — both in New York and across the nation — to embrace a political vision that puts working people over billionaires. Because we believe power ultimately rests with the people — not the billionaire donor class. Stoking fear and threatening political opponents? Sounds an awful lot like how the current administration operates. And that’s not the kind of leadership New York City needs — not now, not ever. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , New York Magazine, September 21, 2025 2\. , Politico, October 27, 2019 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. name: Rev. Raphael Warnock
subject: What matters most to you and your family right now?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend, the GOP-led Senate is finally back in session after the month-long August recess, and Democrats have our work cut out for us.
Donald Trump and his allies in Washington have stripped millions of their health care – and raised premiums on virtually _every_ American – all to fund a tax cut for billionaires.
All the while, Trump’s reckless tariffs continue to push up prices across the board. He even put a tariff on _coffee_ – a crop that the United States largely can’t grow due to our climate. It just goes to show that these tariffs were never about creating jobs here in America. Just like everything Trump does, it’s once again about funding his tax cut for billionaires at your expense.
And it’s not just Trump wreaking havoc on our country. His extreme appointees, like Robert F. Kennedy Jr., are doing everything they can to advance Trump’s dangerous agenda. **Earlier this month, I confronted RFK Jr. at a Senate hearing and told him directly that he should resign or be fired for the conspiracy theories he is spreading and the danger he poses to the health and well-being of every American.**
It’s no surprise that folks in every corner of the country are furious at Trump and his administration. But instead of listening to the American people and changing his policies, Trump is now rigging the electoral maps to silence your voice and stop you from holding him accountable.
**With the Senate back in session, I’m doing everything I possibly can to hold the line against Donald Trump, the GOP-led Senate, and their dangerous policies. But to make sure I’m focused on the things that matter most to you and your family, I need to hear from you directly.**
[**That’s why my team put together a focus group so I can hear from you about your top priorities and concerns. Will you take a moment and join our September Focus Group to let me know what is top of mind for you right now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115928980/571914630/-2028541414?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=250,100,50,25&code=jtk5598-su-nd&refcode=jtk5598-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzI2NjE2ZS00NzlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e0yNTV6ysRA3eI_PcFc6noym8pTZwlth6X29aIs1jt8=&emci=226dcaec-9a98-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=2726616e-479a-f011-b485-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1586379)

Dear Peter,
At our 2025 Convention, Senator Ed Markey delivered a powerful reminder of what we’re up against and why Massachusetts must once again lead the fight for our democracy.

Time and again, Massachusetts has sparked the movements that change America — and we’re ready to do it again. Senator Markey made clear that we will lead on climate action, reproductive freedom, immigrant justice, veterans’ care, and gun safety.

This is our charge as Democrats. To protect our freedoms. To defend democracy. To defeat corruption and greed. And to win the fights that will shape our future.
Thank you for standing shoulder to shoulder in this fight.
In Solidarity,

name: Chris Ahuja
subject: It’s Time to Fight for Families, Not Corporate Greed
body:
The American dream belongs to everyone.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=5e091b2d42&e=5a6ee82cdb)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,Across this country, families are working harder than ever, yet struggling to afford the basics: groceries, rent, gas, and healthcare. Many are barely keeping up, while sky-high housing costs, underemployment, and stagnant wages leave too many trapped.It’s not for lack of effort. Corporations are raking in record profits, billionaires are hoarding wealth, and career politicians in Washington refuse to take bold action. The result? Families are squeezed tighter every day, forced to choose between essentials, while the wealthy and well-connected are rewarded. Enough is enough.I’m running for Congress because families across America deserve an economy that works for them, not just the wealthiest 1%. We need leaders willing to stand up to corporate greed, fight for affordability, and ensure working people aren’t left behind.**Here’s where I stand:****Everyday costs:** From gas to groceries, families are paying more while corporations brag about “record-breaking earnings.” That’s not inflation, it’s price gouging. I will hold corporations accountable and make sure working people aren’t footing the bill for Wall Street greed.**Housing affordability:** Everyone deserves a safe, affordable place to live. Yet rents are soaring while corporate landlords scoop up homes and jack up prices. I will fight for stronger tenant protections, more affordable housing, and policies that stop Wall Street from treating homes like poker chips.**Wages and dignity at work:** Too many workers are stuck in jobs that don’t pay enough to cover basic living costs. I will fight for higher wages, stronger unions, and real worker protections so that a hard day’s work actually means a decent life.**Healthcare costs:** No one should go bankrupt because they get sick. Families pay sky-high premiums while pharmaceutical and insurance companies rake in billions. I will fight to lower prescription drug costs, protect Medicare, and move toward universal, affordable healthcare.This is personal for me. I grew up in a family that understood the value of hard work. My parents didn’t come from money, and I’ve seen first-hand the stress of rising costs and the frustration of politicians who don’t get it.My opponent has been in Congress for nearly 30 years. During that time, the affordability crisis has only worsened. People are tired of excuses. They want action. They want leaders who don’t just talk about change, but fight for it every single day. This campaign is about building that future, not just for California’s 32nd District, but for families across the country. Whether you live in California, Massachusetts, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, or anywhere else, the fight for affordability is the fight for dignity, fairness, and democracy.Taking on entrenched power requires building a movement, and that movement is powered by you. Every contribution helps us get the message out, organize supporters, and prove that people, not corporations, will decide the future of this country.If you believe that families should come before corporations, that affordability is a right, not a privilege, I’m asking you to stand with me today.

Unlike our opponent, our strategy to flip Virginia blue depends on the small donations of people like you. And when we say small donations, we mean it. This month, our average gift is around $40. | Did you see this recent headline in _Politico_? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115930695/571920689/-1861291874?refcode=20250925_FR_45DO_Politico&amount=35&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjU5YzgyZi00YjlhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jfjQbhRxpiTGE1mFRR_hQwPmFg-6jVpDhTbObgc9twU=) _This is incredibly promising news._ Top advisers in the Republican campaign to stop Proposition 50 feel like they are _losing_ momentum. They’ve spent MILLIONS on old school TV ads and attack direct mailers — but they are getting out-hustled by our grassroots team on the ground. Dear Friend, I was planning to write and tell you all about our incredible August 16th **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** **DAY** event at the Library of Congress to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”But then the reports started coming in from parents and grandparents across the country about the opposition they faced at their **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** events. Friend, I know the mainstream media won’t spend a second telling you what happened so I will.In Cuyahoga, OH, protestors formed an intimidating gauntlet at the entrance to the public library. Parents had to shepherd their children through it as if they were criminals just to get into our event. Then inside, while BRAVE families were hearing books about Godly virtues, protestors held up their own inappropriate books showing pornographic content, including one depicting sexual acts between two men.In Highlands Ranch, CO, a group of grandparents invited a local deputy to read the BRAVE book, _The Test of Lionhood_ which teaches children the importance of courage, perseverance and masculinity. When the unhinged atheists at the _Freedom from Religion Foundation_ got wind of the grandparents’ effort to share these virtues with Colorado children, they fired off a threatening letter to the Sheriff’s Department.

Tobias Read

name: Elizabeth Warren (via Democrats.org)
subject: Trump is trying to rebrand his Big, Ugly Bill
body:
---
Derek, Did you see this update? Trump is telling Republicans to rebrand his “One Big Beautiful Bill” as the “Working Families Tax Plan Bill.” Give me a break. A new name won’t change the fact that this bill **rips health care away from millions of people** to fund tax breaks for billionaires. A new name won’t change the fact that this bill **robs 22 million families of their SNAP benefits.** Americans hate this bill. More than 64 percent of voters view it unfavorably, including two-thirds of non-MAGA Republicans. No amount of flashy, poll-tested branding can make up for the real pain and destruction working families will feel. This is Trump’s classic playbook: He says he supports working families, but pushes policies that actually make life harder for them. **I’m not letting Trump throw working families under the bus with no consequences. I’ll keep calling out his lies, and I’ll keep traveling across the country to connect with voters and bring them into our movement — one that’s actually fighting for working families through plans like universal child care, paid leave, and taxing the rich.** **[If you’re with me in this fight, I hope you’ll consider splitting $20 or whatever you can between my campaign and the DNC. Democrats are leading so much of the work to make sure _everyone_ knows the consequences of Trump’s agenda, and to elect more leaders who will actually fight for working families:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-warren-split?refcode=em_20250925_4645_fr&amount=20&refcode2=4645_22930333_RRjR3q&akid=4645%2E22930333%2ERRjR3q)**

name: Team Emerge
subject: how are you holding up?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emerge America

**Peter, did you catch David on the I’ve Had It podcast last week?**
It was a brutally honest, fired-up conversation about the state of the Democratic Party, Trump, and how Leaders We Deserve is shaking things up.
We highly recommend listening, but in case you don’t have time, here are some quick highlights of David, Pumps, and Jennifer’s conversation:
**
* With the country in crisis, Democrats fail to lead because they’re worried about donors instead of the people. They won’t change unless a serious primary reminds them that public office is a privilege, not a right.

* AIPAC and special interests’ influence is turning the Democratic Party into “MAGA-by-extension.”

* NY Dems refusing to back Zohran? A “circus of BS” — and it’s tanking the party even further by alienating progressive voters.

* DC leadership’s strategy to defeat Trump? Strongly worded letters and press conferences... in the year of 2025.

* Dems are missing a slam dunk opportunity to tell working class Americans that MAGA lied. They’re not “America First,” they’re _billionaire_ first.

* Meanwhile, Leaders We Deserve is helping young, working-class progressives beat the odds and create the change we desperately need.
**
Another major interview on the books means more momentum for LWD. We can’t let this moment slip away.
Peter, if you’ve _had it_ with do-nothing Democrats scared to take on Trump and their corporate rulers, it’s time to help take our power back and join our movement.

body:
Here's what's happening in the Forward world...

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=1)

Thursday, September 25, 2025 | Peter -- We issued a big wave of nationwide endorsements! We are proud to announce our biggest wave yet of 2025 candidate endorsements. Across the country, leaders from all walks of life are stepping up to bring problem-solving, collaboration, and accountability back into our politics. These candidates are farmers, small business owners, veterans, community leaders, and reformers who are committed to governing with respect for the Constitution and a focus on solutions — not partisan point-scoring. You can read more about this exciting slate[ here](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/blog/forward-party-announces-big-wave-of-2025-candidate-endorsements/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=2). This big round of endorsements reflects what we’re building together: a growing movement of Americans who believe our politics can be healthier, more honest, and more effective. With each new endorsement, we’re strengthening the ranks of candidates who are ready to represent their communities with integrity and common sense. 👉 Check out the growing list of endorsed candidates here:[ forwardparty.com/candidates](https://www.forwardparty.com/candidates?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=3) At the same time, we’re standing firm on the principles that make our democracy strong. The Forward Party recently issued a statement affirming that freedom of speech — guaranteed by the First Amendment — is non-negotiable, and that political disagreements must be resolved through debate, elections, and the rule of law. Upholding these constitutional protections is central to everything we do, from candidate endorsements to advocating for civil discourse in our communities. You can read the full statement on Jimmy Kimmel[ here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=mhUdGCm_eEqxEEjcw0-lGbIN6AZpbu4iFxE-qCh2CjGeFyc_1ppja9v5tJ3h-zTLBxofyoCynkhztIpd4awy9A&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=4). Together, this wave of endorsements and our unwavering commitment to constitutional principles send a clear message: Forward is here to change the tone of politics in America. We’re building a party that elevates leaders of principle, rejects tribalism, and stands firm for a democracy where every citizen can participate freely and safely. There is no better time than now to get your awesome Forward merch to wear during tonight's women's committee call, upcoming volunteer events, or anywhere you want to show your Forward pride. The hoodies are running low, so grab them now before we have to restock. Click [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=97vo83vzLU7BnykmHxrcoxzp0pgnX_1wVzitlIaoLF8KVTpJKrHDI0wcxZUP6UyA04w5tvQ9iI2eAvH__4UcoQ30pqUiVXOrP7Xp_B7p_DLGPtd87if7cev9JgwrvDd3&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=5) to get your merch!!
**[Forward CEO Lindsey Drath Joined Fox 5 D.C. to discuss a possible government shutdown ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=c1vIqT8LaeJ1yAWpG61iLt_0vyaDuRtiF0CjNaUnLzA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=6)| Fox 5** As a potential government shutdown looms due to a funding standoff in Congress, Forward CEO Lindsey Drath joined Fox 5 D.C. to explain how this type of disfunction hurts everyone. [**Forward Party’s Sen. Thatcher kickstarts Utah’s congressional map conversation** ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KJIq8bn-hjzfGEfx24Ujf1cu9ghFUqJOGm4yb_0e-GqL58APKEiBFNIM_H-3kj4c5iLe2BYnSZSeaDdcBq_pg1W_8Sqko7cKZTVvEVqZcorsrxiLHLgmvllAufK7VsB7LWrQyTGfm6pn1bt2hQRMneCSRTLFPAfTLSHGj16g0B0&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=7)| **KUER** The lone member of the Utah Legislature who is not a Republican or Democrat has thrown his own proposed map in the ring, fresh off a Utah Supreme Court decision. **[Bob Perls on Building the Forward Party in New Mexico](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=1l4Ft3q0DvtDjfhjK0JR6ueVwHnav9rkZdzfebTEMixMKxoSdv3Y84Z-P83B6uWk09qjdfDSYurf5zqgS5OKywQGKS0K3QOvKjVApkDCV8d5BTyBz1xpMDlelPJ8U55dTbHkvQ-iUXA73m66COavtA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_big_wave_of_endorsements_and&n=8)** | **New Mexico Sun** Bob Perls, chairman of the Forward Party of New Mexico, is working to create what he calls “a mainstream alternative to the two parties that have tracked along the extremes.”

We are going to host a kickoff party where we share all the ways to get engaged with us, and give away a little merch. body:

---
Team — The GOP’s audacity knows no limits. Arizona Republican Rep. David Schweikert just called concerns about 194,000 Arizonans losing Medicaid coverage "whining and bedwetting." **That's right — Schweikert thinks it's "whining" when Arizona families worry about losing their health insurance, while defending tax cuts for billionaires. Need we say more?** | [PITCH IN TO FLIP AZ-01 BLUE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115932546/571926864/1948356670?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250925_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzFkYjQyY2EtNTA5YS1mMDExLWI0ODUtNjA0NWJkYTlkOTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vSCG6CKQvlZLAcSMpK6TPWuJdlrvXdjfnakIQfr8r9U=)
---
Let's be clear about what he’s defending:
* **194,000 Arizonans** projected to lose Medicaid coverage
* **1 in 5 people in his own district** depend on Medicaid — 12,601 of whom would lose coverage
* **More than 55% of Arizona hospitals** forced to operate in the red, risking closures across the state
* **$33.1 billion** slashed from Arizona's healthcare spending

But wait, it gets worse.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: MAGA will shut down the government just to block health care
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Trump and Congressional Republicans want to shut down the government so that you can't get health care.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250925-5468-footer&t=1&akid=5468%2E420207%2E8SsSwg)
Peter,
With less than one week until a potential government shutdown, President Trump is doing what he does best: blowing up negotiations, spreading lies, and playing political games with the lives of poor and working Americans.
Why? Because Trump, Congressional Republicans, and their corporate allies would rather shut the government down than protect health care for poor and working people.
Trump was never serious about securing a deal. He demanded Democrats accept the extreme MAGA House bill with zero input, and then called any counteroffer “ridiculous and unserious” before cancelling a meeting to negotiate.
What exactly does he think is so ridiculous?
* **Is it stopping devastating cuts that will kick millions off Medicaid?**
* **Is it extending funding that helps working families afford health insurance?**
* **Is it helping families who will see their premiums skyrocket next year if we don’t act now?**

That’s not ridiculous. That’s common sense.
Peter, there’s been lots of debate about what Democrats should do next. But make no mistake:
**If the government shuts down next week, it’ll be because Trump and Congressional Republicans wanted it to — full stop.**
Mike Johnson also just cancelled the final House workdays before the deadline, cutting off the last chance to pass a new bill and keep the government open.
It’s because Republicans have zero incentive to make a deal — they know they can skip work and still get paid while federal employees work without pay.
But Democrats are ready to pass a funding bill right now to keep the government open and protect health care.
Next week is pivotal — not just because of the shutdown, but also because of our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.
We’re facing two critical tests of our grassroots movement’s power. Please help us meet the moment, stand up for working people, and protect access to health care.
[**Can you pitch in $3 or anything you can today to help keep up this fight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250925-1?refcode=em20250925-5468&amount=3&refcode2=5468_420207_8SsSwg&akid=5468%2E420207%2E8SsSwg)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

The GOP power grab started in Texas. Missouri _just_ did it, too. Now, Indiana wants to be next. Republicans in Indiana could pass their own extreme gerrymander, and soon. I want to brief you on how this happened — but first, [**will you chip in to help us push back against the GOP’s latest attempt to cheat their way to victory in the midterm elections?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115933709/571930975/1110433579?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_IndianaUpdate_email_20250925-NDRC-Tier1-IndianaUpdate_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250925-NDRC-Tier1-IndianaUpdate_&utm_campaign=IndianaUpdate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwM2Q0OTk1LTUyOWEtZjAxMS1iNDg1LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=a-doSlcAmaIsGseM5X9cefjIqEUN3WNVles1bAP4QJI=) Indiana is the latest stop on Donald Trump’s campaign to rig the midterm elections. And he’s using the same authoritarian strategy deployed in Texas and Missouri. The Trump White House even sent JD Vance to Indiana to pressure legislators to further gerrymander the state’s congressional map. **This is an egregious attempt to rig federal elections and cheat the American people out of a voice.** Republicans in the Hoosier State have a choice: They can stand up against the authoritarian regime in Washington and reject this attempt to steal an election — just as Republicans in Georgia and Arizona did in 2020. Or they can roll over to Donald Trump, sacrificing the rights and freedoms of all Americans, and meet the wall of resistance Texas Republicans are seeing right now. **The good news is, there’s growing opposition to this gerrymander. name: Mark Kelly
subject: I know I owe you this
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I often get asked what I’m doing, right now, to counter Trump.
#

Folks, Mark Kelly here.
I often get asked what I’m doing right now to counter Trump.
I think I owe it to you to explain what exactly it is that I’m doing, and why I’m doing it.
First off, I’m talking to Republicans. I know that might not sound all that impressive, but with tensions as high as they are, it’s getting kind of rare. I’m trying to continue to set an example and show you can still find common ground with people you disagree with.
What we do in response makes all the difference. I firmly believe that the only way we’ll see ourselves out of the situation we are in now, the only way we can bring back some real accountability, is by retaking majorities in the House and Senate. And that’s exactly what I’ve been working towards.
In Arizona, I’m working to support the Arizona Democratic Party and our slate of candidates. I’m making sure the people running — from the top of the ballot to the bottom — are getting the help they need from me. And I continue to help build out the infrastructure it’s going to take to win across the state next year.
And around the country, I’m doing the same thing. In the Senate, we need to defend all of our seats and grab a few more to win a majority. I took the Vice Chair position at the DSCC because I knew I could make a difference by helping out the candidates running in those races.
I’m not doing any of this for attention, publicity, or a thank you. I’m doing it because it’s what I can do to turn things around, and because we have to win next year.
Now, if any of that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, I’ve got a humble request for you:
[**This work does not happen without the support of people like you. So, I’m asking you to chip in today, because we’ve got an FEC reporting deadline on September 30th. It’s critical that we show strength in that report. Can I count on you?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept25/.-bETEu&refcode=em250925-1-800k&t=1&akid=6194%2E6688874%2EZCdcVv)

body:
My mother fled Cuba with nothing. Now I fight for Virginia's future.| | | Friend, I wanted to share something personal about why this fight means everything to me.

My mother, Miriam, fled Communist Cuba with nothing — **penniless and homeless, but determined to find freedom in America.** She came to Virginia and raised me to appreciate what we have here: freedom, fairness, and justice for all.
---
[](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/s/c/c71dxnODCj-CgBYKbZF8yY84qpXoHEC2UT10wunnguxGhHqmaofOVJmNkwuFFpL6ZkiCHeeDONXiRWC1KNXhBThkygGivVyfVxhYJNqitddfsibPCDIIkjVDPWbVJp_uR_hH8N41GFZkDII-q7ZUO7wMktNtKJpBgKoJ-stOsGWf8bQlAtmA3Menejy7Agwdh6msFTac4fZlbTdBrpI8w8IqlAI9PUc5-QgX0eMM2-Mi2flYFsANT2bQiybLfePyPd_ixd8yqbmAyrmT_OndJXLwcEbXeeCpWJzta3s94eKaDP-Xwm7yu3nL6WcDwvMjcxLfUhk72WBk7U4j-pkxpf5qLx3Gla5tjstgtc2rztQfmC8kqCKRYpg3jMwIN-O29WQt7AbyK9t6PZpF31CE7cFF37oWqOaC2VesxliyDVFaiZxBQhbKSqqrx2OG6cLVDQIEwcaP7ks-XjMRsejVawQRMjdv1Hat7Rh8yxfu1h7V93qKTqcxOmXgHI0awMt9kaXlNenL87seG4GT7YIg5cfWGs8EiPuNUaZQB-U_pWR15_IW5L6aT4JVJbUBIxJttqtkB8R56vOpB5zhv3NY/cKFwxWrTtTCGR-EdZf-A1E9ZpoMuhMVE/13)
---
**Nearly fifty years later, she was able to vote for me to represent her in the Virginia House of Delegates.** That moment — watching my mother cast that ballot — reminded me of what we're really fighting for.

clean_body: My mother fled Cuba with nothing. Now I fight for Virginia's future.| | | Friend, I wanted to share something personal about why this fight means everything to me. My mother, Miriam, fled Communist Cuba with nothing — penniless and homeless, but determined to find freedom in America. She came to Virginia and raised me to appreciate what we have here: freedom, fairness, and justice for all. Nearly fifty years later, she was able to vote for me to represent her in the Virginia House of Delegates. That moment — watching my mother cast that ballot — reminded me of what we're really fighting for. Today, I'm the proud father of three girls. And as Virginia's Attorney General, I've spent every day working to protect the future they'll inherit. We've secured over $1 billion from Big Pharma to fight the opioid crisis that's destroyed too many families. We launched Operation Ceasefire, cutting violent crime and homicides to record levels. We stood up to school boards when they failed our children — and we got justice. This November, the choice is clear. Jay Jones wants political revenge. I want to keep Virginia moving forward. From the son of a Cuban refugee to Virginia's first Latino statewide elected official — this is my story. This is our fight. Jason Miyares,Attorney General of Virginia | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Miyares for Virginia | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | | |

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Are you on some of these other email lists?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
You are not an ATM.
#
Are you on other political email lists?
If so, you probably regularly receive urgent and panicky emails asking for money. **Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM**. They use scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating.
It’s bad, and getting worse. Team AOC is determined to rise above that and treat you and our other grassroots supporters with respect. **Here’s what we believe:**
* Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action. Because your time and your dollar are both valuable.
* Instead of guilt tripping you, we want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative content because Alexandria believes that an educated community is an empowered community.
* Instead of misleading you about fake "5x matches" or faux threats, we’re honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.
* Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and causes who need it.

**But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have goals and deadlines.** But we’re not going to scare or scam you into donating. We’ll just ask nicely because your support of Alexandria and this movement is important and meaningful.
[Can you make a $5 donation to Alexandria's campaign today? We're planning to get back on the road to host town halls in red, blue, and purple districts across the country — help us keep the Fighting Oligarchy tour strong.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250925.vjyNYo&refcode=em20250925-9826-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9826%2E2526796%2E3XuEyD)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250925.vjyNYo&refcode=em20250925-9826-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=9826%2E2526796%2E3XuEyD)**
Whether or not you can contribute today, **thank you for standing with us**. We appreciate you reading our and Alexandria's emails.
The truth is that this email list is powerful. It’s powerful precisely because _you’re_ here with so many others. When so many of us take collective action all at once, we can make real change.
So, maybe you can’t [**donate right now**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250925.vjyNYo&refcode=em20250925-9826-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=9826%2E2526796%2E3XuEyD). But maybe you’ll get something of value from the next email we send. Or perhaps you’ll join us for a volunteer activity down the road.
No matter what: **we’re glad you’re here**. Thank you for being part of this movement.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250925?refcode=em20250925-9826-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=22&refcode2=9826_2526796_3XuEyD&akid=9826%2E2526796%2E3XuEyD)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250925-9826-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=23&akid=9826%2E2526796%2E3XuEyD)**

Who are we? Progressives in Congress like me, Elizabeth Warren, Greg Casar, Pramila Jayapal, and Bernie Sanders – the people working to stop fascism and fight for working people.

**But there aren't enough of us, Peter. And it’s on us to recruit more progressives across the country.**

So what’s stopping us? Short answer: Nothing. We’ll never stop fighting for change. But there are _obstacles_ along the way... like money.

The hardest part of launching any campaign is making sure a candidate has the resources they need to hire organizers, build a presence, and connect with supporters. Ever wondered why I drove for Uber during my first campaign? Now you know.

body:
When political and corporate elites decide what voices the public can hear, it’s not democracy. It’s censorship. | |
---
Peter, Jimmy Kimmel is back on ABC. And his return broke ratings records—even while almost a quarter of Americans couldn’t watch because they are at the mercy of broadcasting corporations desperate to kiss Trump’s ring. Dozens of markets—including Seattle, St. Louis, and Nashville—still can’t see _Jimmy Kimmel Live!_ These two corporate giants own 70 ABC affiliates reaching nearly a quarter of U.S. households. Even after Kimmel’s suspension was lifted, these two affiliates refused to put him back on the air. **Their motive is clear: show allegiance to Trump. For Nexstar, that means greasing the path for a $6.2 billion merger.** 1 This isn’t about late-night comedy. It’s about authoritarian oligarchy. The Supreme Court cannot sit idly by while media billionaires collude with Trump to shred the first amendment and silence dissent. **We’ve set up a simple tool to let executives at NexStar and Sinclair how you feel about their censorship. It just takes a few clicks.** [**Take Action: When political and corporate elites decide what voices the public can hear, it’s not democracy. It’s censorship. Tell Sinclair and NexStar to reinstate Jimmy Kimmel immediately.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38W66zDg_p4F-MO99sDuYI2VJoTnRexw6yAoGbAKP2JFkeBBpG98eWqXxX9NYCkaB6IvCgtZBvtO-U9H9iAIQbQjNsRGdhcwkLpVX5zyW-xVTU8ciebyepjq-P3Q_qITUTwJTIfGNG_OKPviazX5LHENtlUB6NicRPbXQEoc0Kv3GmYRwcE0SEQCZEKERmx5JD0gsQezTdwSZ_w8RlI9wUD7y6ZB5JnSPg2X7Ws8JOdyr3u5SVVqpmnBWN4udS5aF1H2Cz6a-p1TiEnH8qW9JhQLsC_yAkTz400RDU7RpGexg/4k7/qnSVYDGsTA26i0SXH3bTVg/h0/h001.h5-j3sRDCKh9ocdk4nbxqgIurNkfpFJ_WUn0M8WiZ14) [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38W66zDg_p4F-MO99sDuYI2VJoTnRexw6yAoGbAKP2JFkeBBpG98eWqXxX9NYCkaB4dXcFyUnqTainw0MBpHjKFuVgbxc3NxEkOz5IEC704Yi8vl-j5Y91_5yOlZa5-oQQM6SsCuM3RJ0z-jneGFOXXRXBB28TMOdK26_0RRrFJh3NFLeNq6tSwVn7gkcJw49-vBp2xf4dB2tZtu8cjAf5n-Y3lnKr5F32Zju5_aaI1E-x_zmysLiQzeVBH0GLX2xPOGYDcH95SwqPAs3mOjeEwTF6Gjvmt64z1jyOSLCCT3Q/4k7/qnSVYDGsTA26i0SXH3bTVg/h1/h001.josxq649Dz7ey8mxTDmxQsLe1jYIMaD6HPRhcJ2mgas) **Here’s the bottom line:** Authoritarians like Donald Trump never act alone. Their power is continually reinforced by a network of people who make choices between individual gain and solidarity with the rest of us. For Sinclair and NexStar, they want to further entrench their media monopoly, and use those stations to prop up Trump’s regime—greasing the wheels for their next billion-dollar deal. These network affiliates are broadcasting on public airwaves, by a license granted by the American people. #

body:
This race won’t be easy.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=2552%2E582294%2E1EQr_i)
**I’m a small business owner, the proud product of public schools, and a lifelong Manchester resident.**
I know the challenges Granite Staters face because I know the community.
I’ve worked side by side with Granite Staters to tackle these challenges the New Hampshire way: by rolling up our sleeves and coming together.
**Now I’m running for U.S. Senate because Washington desperately needs more of that kind of leadership.**
We need a government that actually works for people. We need someone in the Senate who will protect our freedoms, lower costs, and stand up for working families — not special interests or party bosses. **I’m ready to bring those values to the Senate.**
_But this race won’t be easy._
MAGA Republicans are lining up to flip New Hampshire red, targeting this seat in their plan to take back the Senate. They’ll spend whatever it takes to flip this seat red and install a rubber stamp for Donald Trump’s extreme agenda.
_We can’t let that happen._ Granite Staters deserve a Senator who answers to them — not to Trump and not to the far-right.
That’s the kind of campaign we’re building together. This movement is powered by people like you pitching in what they can, when they can.
**We’re racing toward our 25,000 grassroots donor goal, but we still need approximately 2,000 more people to join us. And with less than a week left until our critical FEC end-of-quarter deadline, we’re running out of time to close the gap.**
[**Can I count on you to be one of the 2,000 grassroots donors who step up before midnight on September 30th? Please make a contribution of any amount right now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250925_2_eoq?refcode=em20250925-2552&amount=5&refcode2=2552_582294_1EQr_i&akid=2552%2E582294%2E1EQr_i)

Every donation — whether it’s $5, $25, $100, or more — sends a message that we’re ready to keep New Hampshire blue and take the fight for our values to the Senate.

Chris

name: Sarah McBride
subject: The fight for paid family and medical leave is deeply personal to me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I truly believe that in the wealthiest nation on earth, the time and ability to get care should not be a matter of luck.
#
**When my husband Andy was battling cancer, we were lucky.**
Lucky to have the flexibility with our jobs that allowed him to focus on the full-time job of getting care — and me to focus on being there by his side through surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy. To marry him and ultimately walk him to his passing.
And while Andy ultimately lost his life to cancer, up until his last breath, we both knew how lucky we were.
**But I truly believe that in the wealthiest nation on earth, the time and ability to get care should not be a matter of luck.**
That’s why I led the effort in the Delaware General Assembly to pass paid family and medical leave, and I was proud that we got it done with bipartisan support.
And now in Congress, I’m fighting to make that same protection a reality for every worker in this country. That’s what the FAMILY Act would do.
This legislation will guarantee dignity and peace of mind for workers and their families as they face the challenges of life — but I need your help as we work to build the support we need to pass it.
[**So, if you agree it’s time for paid family and medical leave, please add your name to join me and co-sign the FAMILY Act.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20250925-family-act/?sourcecode=em20250925-2363&t=1&akid=2363%2E21716%2EymaZ44)

every word all the same.

SIMPLY PUT, THE RADICAL LEFT IS A SICKNESS.

Among its extremism, dissent is no longer allowed.

And if we capitulate, the First Amendment will vanish right before our
very eyes.

Their goal, as we’ve seen dating all the way back to President
Trump’s first term when I defended him from one of the most vile
witch hunts in history, is not to prove their opponents wrong...

_...NO, IT IS TO UTTERLY DESTROY US – PROFESSIONALLY, FINANCIALLY,
AND PERSONALLY – BY ANY MEANS NECESSARY._

Make no mistake, the radical Left has proven above all else that they
have an ideology of zero tolerance and destruction.

WHY ELSE DO YOU THINK THERE WOULD BE MONSTERS OUT THERE WHO CHOSE TO
_CELEBRATE_ AND _PROMOTE_ THE SENSELESS ASSASSINATION OF CHARLIE KIRK?

We cannot be silent in the face of their madness, friend. Anyone
celebrating or justifying the act of MURDER as an acceptable response

future of America.

But let me be clear, these kinds of radical leftists are not as rare

and ruin those close to our President – _including yours truly..._

KNOWS THAT NOT EVEN THE MOST POWERFUL MAN ON THE FACE OF THE PLANET

IT’S TRULY A DIABOLICAL PLOT FROM THE LEFT, BUT SADLY, AT THIS

REST OF MY LIFE.

_I’ve been left with no pardon, no protection (especially after they

hill._

They think they've finally got me in their trap.

But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot

AMERICAN PEOPLE.

With my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can

body:
Take an action October 4-5 for Prop 50.

We’re kicking off a Weekend of Action to build momentum for Prop 50, the Election Rigging Response Act, and we need you October 4–5. Ballots are mailed to voters just days later.
Our field operation is firing on all cylinders. To reach even more voters fast, we’re organizing three ways to plug in:
**[Host a Phone Bank](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/pb-host-2025/?t=1&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)** : Step up as a host to bring people together to make calls to voters. We’ll give you the run-of-show, training slides, and our campaign’s call tool.
[HOST A PHONE BANK](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/pb-host-2025/?t=2&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)
**[Join a Virtual Phone Bank](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/5149?t=3&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)** : Get trained within 30 minutes, then make calls with live support on Zoom. No previous experience needed and you can join us from anywhere in the country.
[JOIN A VIRTUAL PHONE BANK](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/5149?t=4&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)
**[Organize Your People](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/5150?t=5&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)** : Learn how to organize your friends, family, and neighbors, and turn conversations into YES votes for Prop 50.
[JOIN A TRAINING](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/5150?t=6&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr)
Every conversation will count in this election. Pick one (or two!) and sign up today.
Team Newsom

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=7&akid=2600%2E4767699%2E_yi8cr).
Paid for by Yes on 50, The Election Rigging Response Act, Governor Newsom’s Ballot Measure Committee. Committee Top Funders: Fund for Policy Reform, HMP for Prop 50, California Teachers Association.

subject: ICE Shooter Had "ANTI-ICE" on Bullet Casings
body:
Plus, Google Admits: We Censored Americans and It Was Wrong. New for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |

[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=5b4d3eda43&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
Another day, another deadly attack fueled by inflammatory political rhetoric. [This time it was an ICE facility in Dallas](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=03ca86e259&e=567664f14c), with bullet casings literally engraved "ANTI-ICE" - yet the media still claims they "don't know the motive."
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=5a6d41fbec&e=567664f14c)
| |
🚨 **ICE FACILITY ATTACK KILLS TWO INNOCENT PEOPLE**
A gunman climbed onto a rooftop in Dallas and opened fire into an ICE facility and van, killing two detainees and wounding several others. The FBI found bullet casings engraved with "ANTI-ICE" at the scene and confirmed an "ideological motive."
Yet CNN's John Miller went on air claiming "we don't know whether this was an anti-migrant shooting or anti-ICE shooting." Really? The bullets literally said "ANTI-ICE" on them.
This is the second ICE facility attack in just two months, coming hours after Gavin Newsom signed legislation targeting ICE agents and asked "What are you afraid of?"
We break down how dangerous rhetoric from leaders like Joe Cervantes (who compared ICE to the KKK) can contribute to this violence. When media won't honestly report the problem, Democratic leaders have no cover to condemn extremists in their own party.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a87c993717&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
💻 **GOOGLE ADMITS BIDEN CENSORSHIP WAS "WRONG"**
In a stunning admission, Google told Congress that Biden administration pressure to censor Americans was "unacceptable and wrong." The company pledged to restore conservative voices banned for questioning COVID policies and election integrity.
Jonathan Turley notes this vindicates the Great Barrington Declaration doctors who were fired for questioning lockdowns, mask mandates, and school closures - positions now proven correct.
🧬 **TRUMP'S AUTISM RESEARCH TRIGGERS ESTABLISHMENT MELTDOWN**
Trump announced $50 million in autism research funding and warned about potential Tylenol-autism links based on Harvard and Johns Hopkins studies. Autism rates have exploded 400% in 22 years - from 1 in 150 to 1 in 31 children.
The Albuquerque Journal immediately attacked this as "misinformation," ignoring the actual scientific research. Even worse: pregnant women are posting TikTok videos overdosing on Tylenol to "own Trump."
As parents of an autistic child, we welcome ANY research into this crisis. The real guilt should come from refusing to investigate what's happening to our children.

name: Lizzie Fletcher
subject: Texas Redistricting: What’s Next?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
As President Trump and Washington Republicans take their redistricting efforts across the country, Texans are still fighting back.
Immediately after adoption of the newly drawn Texas congressional map, six plaintiff groups acting on behalf of minority Texans filed motions to block use of the new map in the 2026 elections. Each of the plaintiff groups has challenged the maps on the legal basis of illegal minority vote dilution and racial gerrymandering in violation of the 14th and 15th Amendments to the Constitution. These groups presented their motions to a three-judge panel federal court in El Paso, which heard challenges to the existing maps earlier this year and currently holds jurisdiction over redistricting in Texas.
A court hearing on the request to stop the new map from going into effect for the 2026 elections will begin next week, on October 1 and is scheduled to last up to ten days.
As a lawyer, I know how much work goes into preparing for an injunction hearing like this. It’s essentially a short trial. Not surprisingly, there are lots of expenses for those who are challenging the maps. From the lawyers to expert witnesses to travel expenses to and from El Paso, challenging the maps comes with costs of all kinds.
That’s why I am so grateful for those who are helping make sure that these challenges move forward, despite the cost. The Texas Justice Fund has helped lead the fight to ensure our maps are fair, and is supporting the efforts to challenge these maps in court.
I am making a contribution to the Texas Justice Fund , and I hope you will join me in doing so. You can click here to make a contribution to the Texas Justice Fund through our campaign. Every contribution through this link will be directed to TJF to fund the fight for fair maps. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpf_tjf?refcode=lpf_tjf]
Next week’s hearing is the next step in a long process in the fight for fair maps, fair representation, and fair and free elections. We cannot underestimate those that want to undermine those principles. But we also cannot underestimate the strength we have when we come together and do all we can to protect our principles and the people who need us now more than ever to live up to them.
Supporting the Texas Justice Fund is critical to that end. Please join me in supporting TJF today.
Together we can do anything,

body:
#
Peter —
We know we’ve sent a fair number of emails since launching this campaign. So before we ask any more of you, we wanted to take a step back to explain why these emails are important.
As you know, U.S. Senate races are expensive — especially in a state like Texas. We have the second-largest population in America, and there are 20 media markets spanning the state where we’ll have to run ads to get James’ message out to Texans.
It’s a lot of ground to cover, and right now, we’re coming up on our first FEC deadline. It’s the first time we’re legally required to report our fundraising numbers to the public. We’ll have to share who’s funding this campaign and how much we’ve raised — down to the penny.
We need to report the strongest numbers possible to show that our campaign is viable. And we are going to do it without a dime of corporate PAC money. **So how do we show our strength? We need LOTS of people like you chipping in small amounts.**
That’s where messages like this come in. This may surprise you, but the number one source of donations by a landslide is people giving in response to messages like this one — on emails, texts, and social media.
Without it, we’d stand no chance against our opponents’ corporate and billionaire backers. So we’re asking:
[**Will you please consider making a donation to James Talarico’s campaign for the U.S. Senate? This is a people-powered movement. Your support is the backbone of what we’re building.**](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em250925-ak&t=1&akid=70%2E1347274%2E3zfjQh)
Look, one of the best parts of a campaign is organizing — knocking doors or holding events to meet voters who will decide this race.
James believes that the way to win Texas is to go everywhere and talk to everyone. That takes significant resources, and it also means he doesn’t have a ton of time to spend on the phone asking donors for money.
So please know when you give in response to an email like this, you’re making a big difference. You’re keeping James on the road, so he can spend more time talking to voters and giving you updates without worrying about fundraising.
[**If you can, please contribute before our FEC deadline in 5 days. Every dollar counts. No amount is too small.**](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em250925-ak&t=2&akid=70%2E1347274%2E3zfjQh)

Our end-of-quarter deadline is Tuesday at midnight, and we need to raise $10,000 before the clock runs out. [_**Here are five reasons your donation matters now more than ever:**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/115939385/571949345/1762656148?&refcode=E15424-20250925-FiveReasons-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk4MjcyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNmMGIyYTFiLTY3OWEtZjAxMS1iNDg1LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=u7G_h5MQWkUIaX_MrK6FpTrIV1DRrdDmgBCnrYqWebM=) **1\. Millions in attacks**
Our Blue Dogs in Congress are already facing a flood of negative attack ads from GOP Super PACs. Every dollar we raise goes directly toward fighting back. **2\. Defend and expand**
We must protect our frontline Congress members _and_ flip at least 3 more seats to take back the Speaker’s gavel. That’s the math that will end this chaos in Washington. **3\. The polls are razor-thin**
New polling shows the fight for the House Majority is going to be decided by just a few thousand votes in a handful of districts — including ours. **4\. Toss-ups everywhere**

Kimmel is back, but many Americans won’t be able to watch. Two companies — Nexstar and Sinclair — have decided not to air Kimmel on local ABC stations they own. Why, you may ask? Nexstar, the largest TV broadcaster, is currently seeking Donald Trump’s approval for a $6 billion mega-merger deal. If approved, Nexstar would control TV stations reaching 80% of households — violating the cap set by Congress to protect against monopolies. Sinclair, the nation’s second-largest broadcaster, is also waiting on Donald Trump’s approval for a broadcast deal and is planning even larger upcoming deals. These companies may decide that it’s in their best interest to seek regulatory favors from the administration by censoring a critic — but they have to remember that we have anti-corruption laws. **I’m launching an investigation and pressing for answers on potential corruption.** [**If you’re with me, join our call and add your name to affirm that these media conglomerates should not be able to stifle free speech in exchange for regulatory favors. For everyone who spoke up and said Trump's censorship of Kimmel is wrong, your voice mattered. We need to show that we’re not letting Nexstar or Sinclair off the hook either.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-nexstar-sinclair/?source=EMZ27R_COR_E_20250925_V1S1&t=8&akid=2660%2E4032634%2EiyXDG7) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-nexstar-sinclair/?source=EMZ27R_COR_E_20250925_V1S1&t=9&akid=2660%2E4032634%2EiyXDG7)
---
The deals that Nexstar and Sinclair are pushing for need sign off from FCC Chairman Brendan Carr — the guy who got on a podcast last week and told ABC that “we can do this the easy way or the hard way” in response to Jimmy Kimmel’s monologue.
When ABC canceled Kimmel’s show, and _Glee!_ actor Kevin McHale pointed out on Twitter that this move is a part of Project 2025, Chairman Carr responded with a GIF of Jack Nicholson vigorously nodding and smiling.
[](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-nexstar-sinclair/?source=EMZ27R_COR_E_20250925_V1S1&t=10&akid=2660%2E4032634%2EiyXDG7)
---

Seriously?
He also tweeted to applaud Nexstar and Sinclair’s decision to pull Kimmel’s show even after Disney announced it would restore it.
This just looks like corruption in plain sight.
[**Add your name to join me in calling for accountability on whether Nexstar and Sinclair censored a critical voice of Donald Trump to get favorable treatment from him and FCC Chairman Carr.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-nexstar-sinclair/?source=EMZ27R_COR_E_20250925_V1S1&t=11&akid=2660%2E4032634%2EiyXDG7)
I’m going to keep up the fight against the Trump administration’s disturbing efforts to silence free speech — and against corporate media consolidation.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Joshua Jahn: Federal officials identify North Texas man as Dallas ICE shooting suspect," **Dallas Morning News' **Lilly Kersh** \-- "Federal officials named Joshua Jahn, a 29-year-old unemployed Collin County college dropout, as the [suspect who opened fire](https://substack.com/redirect/163cb915-af9a-429f-bc8b-f5ea12a3cd8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the Dallas Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility, [killing a detainee](https://substack.com/redirect/42dd12f8-86db-49e4-859e-3c705c214fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and wounding two others before fatally shooting himself.

Acting U.S. Attorney **Nancy Larson** told reporters Thursday Jahn acted alone in what she described as a "[the very definition of terrorism](https://substack.com/redirect/b752b3e0-754d-43f9-aa28-a9b447c1ae48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/1e5db171-7cc4-4fbf-bc2f-b622d47849ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Investigators found a collection of notes at the suspect's home, Larson said, which indicated he intended to "maximize lethality" against [ICE agents](https://substack.com/redirect/fb0a55eb-d310-4f9f-a4ea-f1b268668136?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- not target detainees. No law enforcement were injured in the shooting.

He hoped his actions would give ICE agents "[real terror](https://substack.com/redirect/163cb915-af9a-429f-bc8b-f5ea12a3cd8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," induce stress in their lives, and interfere with their work, which he called human trafficking, Larson said. Notes described a hatred for the federal government and called ICE employees "people showing up to collect a dirty paycheck."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/1e5db171-7cc4-4fbf-bc2f-b622d47849ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Public records show **Joshua Jahn** owned a 2016 Toyota parked outside of a building near the ICE office, located in the 8100 block of North Stemmons Freeway. Police believe the Jahn "indiscriminately" fired rounds from a long-range rifle from the roof of the building in a targeted, ambush-style attack. Bullets hit the facility and transport vans outside the office.

Larson said Jahn's car was seen with a large ladder hours before the shooting.

**Noah Jahn** , the suspect's brother, told [NBC News](https://substack.com/redirect/1592a5e3-48a1-4c59-94c3-37c091df49e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Joshua Jahn was not interested in politics and had not voiced opposition to ICE. He said his brother was unemployed and planning to move onto their parents' property in Oklahoma. Noah Jahn did not respond to a phone call from _The Dallas Morning News_ requesting comment.

**Joseph Rothrock** , the [Federal Bureau of Investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/b752b3e0-754d-43f9-aa28-a9b447c1ae48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) agent in charge of the Dallas field office, said the gunfire Wednesday is being investigated as "an act of [targeted violence](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd5c1eb-a994-4e3c-8816-f2b0fb152db4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."

Investigators say the words "ANTI-ICE" were written on an unspent round found Wednesday morning at the [scene of a shooting](https://substack.com/redirect/41e14289-e6e0-498a-94cd-402c716b4e2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

On Wednesday afternoon, police barricaded the street outside his family's home on a leafy block in [Fairview](https://substack.com/redirect/9f50e5b8-8d4f-4dd7-91ec-86d3e52badef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a town about 32 miles north of Dallas between Allen and McKinney. Officers in tactical vests, including agents from the FBI, monitored the premises as the home was searched.

Federal officials confirmed Jahn legally obtained the rifle he used in the shooting in August.

In a post on Facebook made in 2022, the suspect's mother criticized Texas' gun laws, accusing state leaders of not addressing [gun violence](https://substack.com/redirect/e1624a12-ea07-447c-bf37-0b4f3e6a5679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and failing residents.**Sharon Jahn** quoted a song by**Jacques Brel** in one post.

"If we only have love / We can melt all the guns / And then give the new world / To our daughters and sons," the post stated.

The family lives near Allen, the site of a [2023 mass shooting](https://substack.com/redirect/40f2b4a4-006e-4019-80fe-5f07f86b0e38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a shopping mall where a gunman fatally shot eight people and injured others.

FBI Director **Kash Patel** said [in a post on X](https://substack.com/redirect/2689f260-c1da-4531-b560-0954953f42a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the FBI has been analyzing devices, data and writings recovered from the home of the suspect.

Patel said the subject, who he did not identify by name, downloaded a document containing a list of Department of Homeland Security facilities, searched several times for "ballistics" and for the video of **Charlie Kirk 's** [assassination](https://substack.com/redirect/cd21507e-6f81-498e-98d8-2d47e849dad1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the days before the shooting and last month searched several apps that tracks the movements of ICE agents, all of which Patel said showed a "high degree" of pre-planning in the attack.

Patel also said investigators found a handwritten note saying, "Hopefully this will give ICE agents real terror, to think, 'is there a sniper with AP rounds on that roof?"

Authorities are investigating [Jahn's background](https://substack.com/redirect/b752b3e0-754d-43f9-aa28-a9b447c1ae48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Larson said Jahn likely deleted evidence from his devices, and investigators did not find evidence of membership to specific groups.

Jahn's LinkedIn profile listed volunteer work with the Boy Scouts of America.

Collin College, a community college with campuses across Collin County, confirmed that he attended the school at various times between Spring 2013 and 2018.

He previously studied mechanical engineering at [The University of Texas at Dallas](https://substack.com/redirect/46140b18-f590-4e00-bf0d-1816b92ff71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from 2014 to 2016. The university's admission's office confirmed he failed most of his classes.

Jahn worked assembling and installing solar panels in D-FW about eight years ago, according to a former employer. Jahn's also listed previous employment at a [cannabis farm](https://substack.com/redirect/c7a9b4e7-f3fb-4d6f-b15e-cf49ae9acfae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the state of Washington and at fast food and retail stores in [Allen](https://substack.com/redirect/6f70c5d9-6cd7-41a0-9638-83dca371278e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Collin County records show Jahn pleaded guilty to a felony [marijuana charge](https://substack.com/redirect/a6640c86-6efd-400f-81a2-bc2a8dd2ada2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a Texas court 2016." [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/26f1a2ce-e481-49f4-8e4f-9c5865af4953?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

* * *
* **TOP NEWS**

**" Data centers are thirsty for Texas' water, but state planners don't know how much they will need" **[Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b787c856-a66c-4e90-a5cb-afb2f97ddd98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
